def gate(label, command, current=False, development=False):
    row, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'}
         and set(row) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
         and all(same(row[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'whole closed native gate')
    need(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == 0 and type(row['expected_status']) is int
         and row['expected_status'] == 0 and row['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(row['programmes'], row['programmes_after']), 'typed distinct observed/declared status and conserved complete source/input epoch')
    own = {name: value for name, value in row['programmes'].items() if Path(name).parent == BASE and Path(name).suffix == '.py'}
    if development:
        epoch = read('development-epochs.json')['epochs'][label]
        need(same(own, epoch['programmes']) and pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes()) == epoch['actual'],
             'whole dated development programme/native epoch')
    else:
        need(same(own, read('formal-programmes.json')['programmes']), 'whole formal programme freeze')
    for name, value in row['programmes'].items():
        body = value['body'].encode() if 'body' in value else bytes.fromhex(value['body_hex'])
        need(pin(body) == value['identity'], 'whole instrument/input body identity')
        if current and not development:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole current instrument/input body')
    stream = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / label
    need(row['stdout_path'] == str(stream / 'stdout.txt') and row['stderr_path'] == str(stream / 'stderr.txt')
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', row['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in row['stderr'], 'whole unchanged guard and same-volume stream routes')
    return pin(canonical(row))


def preflight():
    before = {name: Path(name).read_bytes() for name in publish.NAMES}
    need(all(before[name] == body for name, body in intake.overlays().items()), 'whole declared activation')
    contracts()
    preparation()
    after, measured = publish.transformation(before)
    roles = intake.derive()
    source = intake.live(roles)
    meanings = {role: reader(role) for role in ('context', 'cause', 'consumer')}
    need(source == intake.live(roles), 'whole source conservation around all development saved readers')
    after, measured = publish.transformation(before)
    first, last = nodes(before[TASK]), nodes(after[TASK])
    need(first.keys() == last.keys(), 'whole projected task membership')
    for name, block in first.items():
        need((all(field(block, key) == field(last[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
              and field(last[name], 'Status') == 'done') if name == PLAN['owner'] else block == last[name],
             'whole owned projected contract and every unrelated block')
    physical = metrics({'MEMORY.md': after['MEMORY.md']})
    for row in map(json.loads, after[REGISTRY].splitlines()):
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'active_resume':
            need(all(key == 'files' or value * 100 < row['health_targets'][key] * row['milestones']['warning_pct']
                     for key, value in physical.items()), 'all resume health axes below warning')
        elif row.get('surface_id') in ('task_evidence', 'shipped_behavior'):
            actual = measured['task_metrics' if row['surface_id'] == 'task_evidence' else 'book_after']
            need(all(row['enforcement_ceilings'][key] is None or value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key]
                     for key, value in actual.items()), 'all unchanged task/book physical ceilings')
    factory = public()
    prior, sources = factory['historical'](), factory['sources']()
    record = factory['current_input'](prior, sources)
    record['chapter'] = after[BOOK].decode()
    factory['check'](record, sources, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    snapshots = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(publish.NAMES):
        snapshots[name] = {}
        for role, body in (('before', before[name]), ('after', after[name])):
            path = BASE / ('development-publication-' + role + '-' + str(i) + '.gz')
            need(not path.exists(), 'retain first development publication source')
            path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(body, mtime=0))
            snapshots[name][role] = dict(snapshot=str(path), identity=pin(body))
    save_product('development-meanings.json.gz', meanings)
    save('development-preflight.json', dict(contracts=contracts(), snapshots=snapshots, measured=measured,
        source=source, resume=physical, preparation=preparation()))
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in before.items()), 'whole development targets remain readonly')
    print('PASS development-only complete prerequisite meanings, source/contracts and publication preflight.')


def core(current=False):
    frozen = read('formal-programmes.json')
    need(frozen['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and frozen['phase'] == 'formal'
         and set(frozen['programmes']) == {str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py')}, 'complete formal programme membership')
    for name, value in frozen['programmes'].items():
        need(Path(name).read_bytes() == value['body'].encode() and pin(value['body'].encode()) == value['identity'],
             'whole unchanged formal source')
    normal = read('cause-normal-commit.json')
    commit = re.search(r'^\[[^\]]+ ([0-9a-f]{7,40})\] ', normal['stdout'])
    need(type(normal['status']) is int and normal['status'] == 0
         and normal['command'] == ['git', '--no-pager', 'commit', '-F', 'git_message_brief.txt']
         and '[doctrine] all doctrine checks passed' in normal['stdout'] + normal['stderr']
         and commit is not None and git('rev-parse', commit[1]).decode().strip() == PLAN['revision'],
         'whole prior normal commit/hook/source custody')
    commands = {
        'development-source': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--development'],
        'development-preflight': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'verify.py'), '--preflight'],
        'development-whitespace': ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check'],
        'source-before': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--before'],
        'current-before': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'current_snapshot.py'), 'before'],
        'source-after': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--after'],
        'root-history': ['git', 'log', '-1', '-S', 'Join complete original source context, cause, coordinate and consumer semantics.', '--format=%H %s', '--', 'docs/tasks/']}
    commands.update({'replay-' + role: declaration['command'] for role, declaration in read('reader-contracts.json').items()})
    gates = {label: gate(label, command, current, label.startswith('development-')) for label, command in commands.items()}
    roles = intake.derive()
    need(same(roles, read('source-roles.json')) and read('source-before.json') == read('source-after.json'),
         'whole original/current source roles and replay epoch conserve')
    meanings = {role: reader(role) for role in ('context', 'cause', 'consumer')}
    for role, value in meanings.items():
        need(read('replay-' + role + '-actual.json')['stdout'] == value['stdout'], 'whole native and independently reconstructed reader stdout')
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40} .+\n', read('root-history-actual.json')['stdout']), 'complete original join obligation history')
    developed = read('development-preflight.json')
    need(same(meanings, load_product('development-meanings.json.gz')) and developed['contracts'] == contracts()
         and same(developed['preparation'], preparation()), 'whole development/formal contract/meaning/failure correspondence')
    before = {name: gzip.decompress(Path(entry['before']['snapshot']).read_bytes()) for name, entry in developed['snapshots'].items()}
    after, measured = publish.transformation(before)
    need(same(measured, developed['measured']) and all(gzip.decompress(Path(developed['snapshots'][name]['after']['snapshot']).read_bytes()) == body
         for name, body in after.items()), 'whole reconstructed development publication')
    factory = public()
    prior, sources = factory['historical'](), canonical_sources()
    need(load_product('canonical-before.json.gz') == {name: body.decode() for name, body in sources.items()}, 'all fixed canonical bytes retain')
    factory['check'](load_product('current-before.json.gz'), sources, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], contracts=contracts(), meanings=meanings,
        source=pin(canonical(roles)), source_epoch=read('source-before.json'), preparation=preparation(),
        development=pin(canonical(developed)), normal_commit=pin(canonical(normal)), gates=gates, condition=PLAN['condition'],
        legs=dict(rederive='Whole unchanged contracts and freshly reexecuted complete saved context/cause/consumer meanings, source/current/query/capacity.',
            falsify='Every complete inherited genuine rejecting source/context/cause/coordinate/address/consumer candidate and actual intended outcome retains. Context caught library refusals are distinguished from separate native exits; both preparation failures remain failed.',
            durability='Complete committed sources/native programmes/inputs/commands/statuses/streams/products/controls/failures and source/publication snapshots with explicit after-invocation preparation reconstruction, sealed/default recovery and normal hooks.'))


def delivery(current=False):
    publication = publish.qualify(current)
    before, after = load_product('canonical-before.json.gz'), load_product('canonical-after.json.gz')
    need(same(before, after), 'every canonical fact/question/probe/source byte retains')
    factory = public()
    prior = factory['historical']()
    record = load_product('current-after.json.gz')
    factory['check'](record, {name: body.encode() for name, body in after.items()}, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    need(record['chapter'].encode() == gzip.decompress(Path(publication['snapshots'][BOOK]['after']['snapshot']).read_bytes()), 'whole actual published chapter')
    source = read('source-published.json')
    need(source == dict(read('source-before.json'), overlays={name: pin(body) for name, body in intake.overlays(True).items()}),
         'whole source conservation with only five explicit publication overlays')
    if current:
        need(factory['sources']() == {name: body.encode() for name, body in after.items()}
             and same(intake.live(intake.derive(), True), source), 'whole actual current source/canonical epoch')
    native = book_native.qualify(gzip.decompress((BASE / 'native-chapter.html.gz').read_bytes()).decode())
    need(same(native, read('book-native.json')), 'whole actual native chapter')
    commands = dict(publish.COMMANDS, core=['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'verify.py'), '--core', '--current'],
        publication=['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'admission_publish.py')],
        **{'current-after': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'current_snapshot.py'), 'after'],
           'book-source': ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/book_source_references.py', '--write'],
           'source-published': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--published'],
           'book-native': ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'book_native.py')],
           'whitespace': ['git', 'diff', '--cached', '--check']})
    gates = {label: gate(label, command, current) for label, command in commands.items()}
    need('All tests successful' in read('focused-actual.json')['stdout'], 'actual focused regression success')
    return dict(publication=publication, current=pin(canonical(record)), source=source, native=native, gates=gates)


def catalogue():
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(BASE.iterdir()):
        info = path.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and not path.is_symlink() and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev,
             'whole flat ordinary same-volume admission archive')
        if path.name not in EXCLUDED:
            result[path.name] = dict(**pin(path.read_bytes()), executable=bool(info.st_mode & 0o111))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--preflight', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--core', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--current', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(sum((args.preflight, args.core, args.seal)) <= 1, 'one explicit admission role')
    if args.preflight:
        preflight()
    else:
        result = core(args.current or args.seal)
        if args.core:

        else:
            result['delivery'] = delivery(args.current or args.seal)
            need(json.loads(canonical(result)) == result, 'whole JSON-native proof round trip')
            if args.seal:
                save('proof.json', result)
                save('manifest.json', catalogue())
            else:
                need(same(read('proof.json'), result) and same(read('manifest.json'), catalogue()), 'whole saved immutable prerequisite admission')
            print(SUCCESS, end='')

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/original-join-canonical-preparation-20261012')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
             'scripts/record_value_raw_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_consumer_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_cause_fact.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'}
    plan = json.loads((BASE / 'plan.json').read_bytes())
    names.update(str(BASE / name) for name in ('plan.json', 'book-review.json', 'guide.txt',
        'integration-contract.json', 'association-normal-commit.json', 'activation-task.gz',
        'activation-memory.gz', 'activation-index.gz', 'input-contracts.json',
        'interface-review.json', 'proposal-review.json'))
    names.update(str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py'))
    for role in ('association', 'admission', 'context', 'cause', 'consumer'):
        names.update(str(path) for path in Path(plan[role]).glob('*.py'))
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


def candidate_inputs(command):
    result = {}
    if '--candidate' in command:
        index = command.index('--candidate')
        if index + 1 >= len(command):
            raise ValueError('explicit native candidate input')
        name = command[index + 1]
        path = BASE / name
        if Path(name).name != name or not name.endswith('.json.gz') or path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError('ordinary own complete native candidate input')
        result[str(path)] = pin(path.read_bytes())
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    candidates = candidate_inputs(args.command)
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, candidate_inputs=candidates, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command), candidate_inputs_after=candidate_inputs(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if type(result.returncode) is not int or result.returncode != args.expect or epoch != actual['programmes_after'] or candidates != actual['candidate_inputs_after']:
        raise SystemExit(1)

    need(len({row['label'] for row in rows}) == len(rows), 'unique complete canonical separating declarations')
    return rows


def get(value, path):
    for key in path:
        value = value[key]
    return value


def mutate(candidate, row):
    action, path = row['action'], row['path']
    if action == 'retain':
        return
    parent, key = get(candidate, path[:-1]), path[-1]
    old = parent[key]
    if action == 'set':
        parent[key] = copy.deepcopy(row['value'])
    elif action == 'delete':
        del parent[key]
    elif action == 'pop':
        need(type(old) is list and bool(old), 'genuine nonempty omission target')
        old.pop()
    elif action == 'truncate':
        need(type(old) is str and bool(old), 'whole nonempty string mutation target')
        parent[key] = old[:-1]
    elif action in ('float', 'increment'):
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer mutation target')
        parent[key] = float(old) if action == 'float' else old + 1
    else:
        raise ValueError('undeclared canonical mutation')

    name = 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py'
    body = fixed([name])[name]
    need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole unchanged current canonical factory')

"""Whole committed original meanings, unchanged contracts and finite proposal scope."""
import contextlib
import stat
from preparation_common import *

TARGET = 'docs/knowledge/record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader.md'


def contracts():
    before = nodes(fixed([TASK])[TASK])
    active = nodes(gzip.decompress((BASE / 'activation-task.gz').read_bytes()))
    added = {PLAN[key] for key in ('owner', 'publication', 'acceptance')}
    need(set(active) == set(before) | added and not set(before) & added,
         'exact existing task graph and three declared acceptance children')
    for name, block in before.items():
        if name == PLAN['parent']:
            need(all(field(block, key) == field(active[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Commit'))
                 and field(block, 'Status') == 'pending' and field(active[name], 'Status') == 'active'
                 and field(active[name], 'Children') == ', '.join(PLAN[key] for key in ('owner', 'publication', 'acceptance')),
                 'whole unchanged original acceptance contract and explicit child split')
        else:
            need(block == active[name], 'every unrelated whole original task block retains')
    need(field(active[PLAN['owner']], 'Status') == 'active'
         and all(field(active[PLAN[key]], 'Status') == 'active' for key in ('family', 'join', 'parent'))
         and all(field(active[PLAN[key]], 'Status') == 'pending' for key in ('publication', 'acceptance', 'full_alias')),
         'only preparation active; production original parents and full alias stay separate')
    return {name: body.decode() for name, body in active.items()
            if name == PLAN['family'] or name.startswith(PLAN['family'] + '.') or name == PLAN['full_alias']}


@contextlib.contextmanager
def association_module(entry):
    """Isolate unchanged archived modules from this preparation's same-named modules."""
    root = PLAN['association']
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', root).decode().splitlines()
    programmes = fixed(name for name in names if name.endswith('.py'))
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in programmes.items()),
         'whole unchanged committed association programmes')
    modules = {Path(name).stem for name in programmes} | {'capture'}
    previous = {name: sys.modules[name] for name in modules if name in sys.modules}
    old_path, old_argv = sys.path[:], sys.argv[:]
    try:
        for name in modules:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.path.insert(0, root)
        name = root + '/' + entry + '.py'
        sys.argv[:] = [name]
        namespace = {'__name__': 'fixed_preparation_association_' + entry, '__file__': name}
        exec(compile(programmes[name], name, 'exec'), namespace)
        yield namespace
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = old_path
        sys.argv[:] = old_argv
        for name in modules:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.modules.update(previous)


def inputs():
    declaration = json.loads((BASE / 'input-contracts.json').read_bytes())
    need(set(declaration) == {'command', 'condition', 'inputs', 'scope'}
         and declaration['command'] == ['python3', '-B', PLAN['association'] + '/verify.py']
         and declaration['scope'] == PLAN['condition'], 'closed complete committed association input contract')
    root = PLAN['association']
    wanted = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json', 'source-roles.json', 'candidate.json.gz', 'qualification.json',
              'formal-programmes.json', 'development-initial-programmes.json', 'typed-equality-repair.json',
              'capture-typed-repair-expansion.json', 'capture-candidate-input-expansion.json',
              'development-boolean-alias-actual.json', 'development-float-alias-actual.json',
              'development-boolean-alias-v2-actual.json', 'development-float-alias-v2-actual.json',
              'controls.json', 'plan.json', 'input-contracts.json', 'integration-contract.json'}
    need(set(declaration['inputs']) == {root + '/' + name for name in wanted},
         'complete declared proof native controls first failures repair and source roles')
    bodies = fixed(declaration['inputs'])
    decoded = {}
    for name, body in bodies.items():
        info = Path(name).lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev
             and Path(name).read_bytes() == body and same(pin(body), declaration['inputs'][name]),
             'whole ordinary same-volume fixed association input')
        raw = gzip.decompress(body) if name.endswith('.gz') else body
        value = json.loads(raw)
        if name.endswith('.gz'):
            need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical compressed association candidate')
        decoded[Path(name).name] = value
    with association_module('reader') as reader:
        qualification = reader['check'](decoded['candidate.json.gz'])
    need(same(qualification, decoded['qualification.json'])
         and same(decoded['proof.json']['qualification'], qualification),
         'complete independently rederived original joined meanings and committed proof')
    with association_module('verify') as verifier:
        failures = verifier['failures']()
    need(same(failures, decoded['proof.json']['failures']), 'whole original first false greens and exact typed repairs retain')
    candidate = decoded['candidate.json.gz']
    return dict(identities=declaration['inputs'], contracts=contracts(),
        association=dict(proof=pin(bodies[root + '/proof.json']),
            candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)), qualification=pin(canonical(qualification)),
            manifest=pin(bodies[root + '/manifest.json']), source_roles=pin(bodies[root + '/source-roles.json']),
            controls=decoded['proof.json']['controls'], failures=failures,
            source_model_assumptions=candidate['source_model_assumptions'],
            original_conditions=candidate['original_conditions'], source_role_condition=candidate['source_role_condition'],
            truth_authority=candidate['truth_authority'], assurance=candidate['assurance'],
            condition=decoded['proof.json']['condition']))


def scope(data):
    return dict(condition=PLAN['condition'], original=data['association'],
        assurance=dict(original_native_private=False, later_historical_execution_currency=False,
            original_producer_recapture=False, production=False, original_parent=False, full_alias=False),
        review='Exact paragraph correspondence and explicit engineering equivalence review, supported by complete independently rederived original source associations. Shared qualified prior causes and typed truths are declared premises; no universal natural-language proof or native passed-flag authority.')


def context():
    sources = canonical_sources()
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in sources.items()),
         'every unchanged current canonical source body')
    factory = public()
    prior = factory['historical']()
    current = factory['current_input'](prior, sources)
    factory['check'](current, sources, prior, factory['authority'](prior))
    registry = list(map(json.loads, fixed([REGISTRY])[REGISTRY].splitlines()))
    authority = next(row for row in registry if row.get('surface_id') == 'knowledge_cards')
    return dict(sources=sources, data=inputs(), factory=factory, prior=prior, current=current, authority=authority)

"""Save only a source-bound original-join proposal; production remains unchanged."""
from model import *

if __name__ == '__main__':
    save_product('candidate.json.gz', propose(context()))
    print('Prepared complete non-growing original-join canonical candidate; production remains unchanged.')

    actual, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    extra = {'candidate_inputs'} if 'candidate_inputs' in started else set()
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'} | extra
         and set(actual) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
             | ({'candidate_inputs_after'} if extra else set())
         and all(same(actual[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'closed complete native gate')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == status
         and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == status
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after']), 'typed native declared/observed outcome and conserved source epoch')
    if extra:
        need(same(actual['candidate_inputs'], actual['candidate_inputs_after']), 'whole native candidate input conservation')
        for name, identity in actual['candidate_inputs'].items():
            path = Path(name)
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink()
                 and pin(path.read_bytes()) == identity, 'whole saved native candidate body')
    own = {name: entry for name, entry in actual['programmes'].items() if Path(name).parent == BASE and Path(name).suffix == '.py'}
    if development:
        epoch = read('development-epochs.json')['epochs'][label]
        need(same(own, epoch['programmes']) and pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes()) == epoch['actual'],
             'complete dated development source/native epoch')
    else:
        need(same(own, read('formal-programmes.json')['programmes']), 'whole frozen formal programme membership and bodies')
    for name, raw in bodies(actual['programmes']):
        if current and not development:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'whole current native programme/input body')
    stream = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / label
    need(actual['stdout_path'] == str(stream / 'stdout.txt') and actual['stderr_path'] == str(stream / 'stderr.txt')
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in actual['stderr'], 'unchanged guard and repository-local full terminal routes')
    return pin(canonical(actual))


def stream_namespace():
    """Compare every complete fixed archived body without accumulating negative cases."""
    root = PLAN['association']
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', root).decode().splitlines()
    need(names == sorted(str(path) for path in Path(root).iterdir()), 'complete fixed flat association namespace')
    result = {}
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for name in names:
            info = Path(name).lstat()
            need(Path(name).parent == Path(root) and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                 and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev, 'ordinary same-volume fixed association namespace')
            process.stdin.write((PLAN['revision'] + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'whole fixed association blob header')
            remaining = int(header[2])
            import hashlib
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with Path(name).open('rb') as local:
                while remaining:
                    size = min(1048576, remaining)
                    body = process.stdout.read(size)
                    need(len(body) == size and local.read(size) == body, 'whole streamed fixed association source bytes')
                    digest.update(body)
                    remaining -= size
                need(local.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole fixed association EOF')
            result[name] = dict(bytes=int(header[2]), sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(info.st_mode & 0o111))
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stdout.read(1) == b'' and process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0,
             'whole native read-only streamed Git source result')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    manifest = json.loads(Path(root, 'manifest.json').read_bytes())
    excluded = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json'} | {label + suffix for label in
        ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines') for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}
    need(same(manifest, {Path(name).name: value for name, value in result.items() if Path(name).name not in excluded}),
         'complete committed source proof native control failure repair catalogue')
    return result


def fresh_association():
    before = stream_namespace()
    terminal = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(terminal):
        with association_module('verify') as namespace:
            entry = PLAN['association'] + '/verify.py'

"""Save each complete native guard terminal outside the guarded process tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/primary-raw-cause-association-20261011')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
             'scripts/record_value_raw_fact.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'}
    names.update(str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py'))
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts/primary-raw-cause-association-20261011/checks') / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if type(result.returncode) is not int or result.returncode != args.expect or epoch != actual['programmes_after']:
        raise SystemExit(1)

import gzip
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from capture import BASE, pin, save

MODES = ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls')
DOMAINS = ('api', 'copies', 'parses', 'test_run')
CAPTURE = 'docs/audits/record-value-original-candidate-20261004'
CONTEXT = 'docs/audits/record-value-original-contexts-20261005'
RAW = 'docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/raw-product.json'
INPUTS = {
    **{mode: CAPTURE + '/' + mode + '.json' for mode in MODES},
    'primary': PLAN['primary'] + '/proofs.json',
    'contexts': CONTEXT + '/proofs.json',
    'execution': CAPTURE + '/execution.json',
    'raw': RAW,
    'semantic': PLAN['semantic'] + '/candidate.json.gz',
    'preparation': PLAN['preparation'] + '/proof.json',
}
SCOPE = ('Complete finite independent original primary/raw cause association, including all empty API/parser/private/test-run members, '
         'own source/helper/parser membership, whole raw bodies and qualified coordinate/address and nested roles. '
         'Qualified original source products remain shared assumptions. Native acceptance truth is source-derived only for API/parser calls; '
         'private/test-run observations retain their prerequisite scope. Helpers select their first failed operation, without a separate raw-error domain. '
         'Original native class/provider/settings/flags/encoding/private framework/hidden arguments/CODE-CODE/cross-call/heap identities remain unmeasured. '
         'Canonical/cause-parent/consumer/alias/cold/permanent/host-native/visual/HIAL/full-CI/push remain separately owned.')


def need(condition, cause):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def same(left, right):
    return canonical(left) == canonical(right)


def nodes(body):
    starts = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n', body, re.M))
    result = {row[1].decode(): body[row.start():starts[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(starts) else len(body)]
              for i, row in enumerate(starts)}
    need(len(result) == len(starts), 'unique complete cause task graph')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1].decode() if match else None


def legacy_digest(value):
    return pin(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode())


def module(path):
    # Original finite model modules execute no main routine on import and make
    # no sibling sys.path/module-name mutations. They are qualified assumptions.
    namespace = {'__name__': 'qualified_original_cause_model'}
    exec(compile(Path(path).read_bytes(), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace


def inputs():
    source = json.loads((BASE / 'source-roles.json').read_bytes())['publication']['members']
    data, identities = {}, {}
    for role, name in INPUTS.items():
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        identity = pin(raw)
        need(identity == {key: source[name][key] for key in ('bytes', 'sha256')},
             'whole fixed qualified source product: ' + role)
        data[role] = json.loads(gzip.decompress(raw) if name.endswith('.gz') else raw)
        identities[name] = identity
    return data, identities


def product(path):
    raw = gzip.decompress(Path(path).read_bytes())
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical compressed cause product')
    return value


def save_product(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    need(not path.exists() and path.parent == BASE, 'retain first complete cause product')
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(value), mtime=0))


def boundary(data):
    return dict(scope=SCOPE, preparation=data['preparation']['unknowns'],
                raw=data['semantic']['original_unknowns'], semantic=data['semantic']['semantic_links']['original_unknowns'])

    def group(value):

    allocation = 'whole ordered nonempty and empty operation allocation'
    source = 'whole own source argument/helper/parser/caller association'

        ('wrong-first-cause', lambda value: api(value).update(primary='Unrelated source cause'), 'whole independently derived own first cause'),

        ('wrong-product', lambda value: api(value, 0)['product'].update(sha256='0' * 64), 'whole own original native and product association'),
        ('borrow-raw', lambda value: api(value).update(raw=api(value, second)['raw']), raw),

        ('empty-borrows-raw', lambda value: api(value, 0).update(raw=api(value)['raw']), 'complete empty error has no borrowed raw or semantic member'),
        ('borrow-api-cause', lambda value: api(value)['semantic']['first_cause'].update(index=second), semantic),

        ('truncate-inner-cause', lambda value: api(value, nested[2])['semantic']['forwarding'].update(whole_inner_body=api(value, nested[2])['semantic']['forwarding']['whole_inner_body'][:-1]), 'whole nested own inner operand outer prefix and new trace'),
        ('reverse-nested-phases', lambda value: api(value, nested[2])['semantic']['phases'].reverse(), qualified),
        ('borrow-helper-first', lambda value: value['modes'][0]['helpers'][0]['first_record'].__setitem__(2, second), helper),
        ('omit-helper', lambda value: value['modes'][0]['helpers'].pop(), 'complete source helper population'),

def run(label, candidate, expected, cause):
    path = BASE / (label + '.json.gz')

                   candidate=dict(path=str(path), identity=pin(path.read_bytes())), programmes=programme)
    save('control-' + label + '-started.json', started)
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)

                  programmes_after={name: dict(body=Path(name).read_text(), identity=pin(Path(name).read_bytes())) for name in programme})
    save('control-' + label + '-actual.json', actual)
    # The complete unexpected outcome has already been preserved before judging.

             and result.stderr == '', 'whole positive native association output')
    return pin(canonical(actual))

def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own read-only fixed Git result')
    return result.stdout


def derive():
    fact.preparation()
    original = json.loads((fact.PREPARATION / 'source-v3.json').read_bytes())
    fact.source_census(original)
    prior = json.loads((Path(PLAN['preparation']) / 'source-roles.json').read_bytes())
    selected = set(prior['publication']['roots']) | {PLAN['preparation']}
    roots = sorted(name for name in selected if not any(name.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if name != other))
    entries = {}
    for record in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', PLAN['revision'], '--', *roots).rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        header, raw_name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = header.decode().split()
        name = raw_name.decode()
        plane.relative(name)
        need(kind == 'blob' and mode in ('100644', '100755') and name not in entries,
             'unique ordinary complete publication source member')
        old = original['members'].get(name)
        if old and old['oid'] == oid and old['mode'] == mode:
            entries[name] = old
        else:
            body = git('cat-file', 'blob', oid)
            entries[name] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid, **pin(body))
    need(set(original['members']) <= set(entries), 'every complete original source member retains')
    changed = {name: dict(original=old, publication=entries[name]) for name, old in original['members'].items()
               if old != entries[name]}
    code = {name for name in changed if Path(name).suffix in ('.py', '.pl', '.pm', '.sh', '.js', '.t')}
    need(code <= {'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'},
         'only explicit maintained publication instruments advance; original semantic programmes retain')
    source = dict(revision=PLAN['revision'], roots=roots, members=entries,
        directories=sorted({str(parent) for name in entries for parent in Path(name).parents if str(parent) != '.'}))
    fact.source_census(source)
    return dict(original=original, publication=source, changed=changed,
        condition='Original complete reader/source/native roles retain their fixed 2ca and earlier e428 conditions. Current canonical production is separately bound to the clean publication/cleanup commit. No later original-programme currency or native/private recapture is inferred.')


def overlays(after=False):
    return {name: gzip.decompress((BASE / snapshot).read_bytes()) for name, snapshot in OVERLAYS.items()}


def live(roles, after=False):
    source = roles['publication']
    activation = overlays(after)
    expected = {name: {key: row[key] for key in ('bytes', 'sha256')} for name, row in source['members'].items()}
    expected.update({name: pin(body) for name, body in activation.items()})
    members = set()
    for root_name in source['roots']:
        root = Path(root_name)
        plane.local_parents(plane.ROOT / root / 'endpoint' if root.is_dir() else plane.ROOT / root)
        if root.is_dir():
            declared = {str(Path(name).relative_to(root)): row for name, row in expected.items()
                        if name.startswith(root_name + '/')}
            namespace.check_tree(root, declared)
            result = subprocess.run(['rg', '--files', '--hidden', '--no-ignore', '--', root_name], capture_output=True, text=True)
            need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == '', 'actual independent complete source directory census')
            members.update(result.stdout.splitlines())
        else:
            need(root_name in expected, 'declared complete source file root')
            members.add(root_name)
    need(members == set(expected), 'whole independent fixed/current source file membership')
    for name in sorted(members):
        path = Path(name)
        info = path.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev
             and bool(info.st_mode & 0o111) == (source['members'][name]['mode'] == '100755'),
             'ordinary same-volume complete current source mode')
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
                digest.update(chunk)
        after = path.stat()
        need((info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns) ==
             (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
             and dict(bytes=after.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest()) == expected[name],
             'whole fixed publication or declared activation source bytes')
    return dict(source=pin(canonical(source)), overlays={name: pin(body) for name, body in activation.items()},
                members=sorted(members), condition=roles['condition'])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--before', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(args.before != args.after, 'one explicit source census epoch')
    roles = derive()
    if args.before:
        save('source-roles.json', roles)
    else:
        need(json.loads((BASE / 'source-roles.json').read_bytes()) == roles, 'whole original/current source roles conserve')
    result = live(roles, args.after)
    if args.after:

        need(expected == result, 'whole source census conserves in the unchanged source epoch')
    save('source-' + ('before' if args.before else 'after') + '.json', result)
    print(SUCCESS, end='')

    main()

                 and field(final[name], 'Status') == 'done', 'only unchanged association child closes')

            need(block == final[name], 'every unrelated complete task block retains')
    need(field(final[PLAN['parent']], 'Status') == 'active' and field(final[PLAN['parent'] + '.1'], 'Status') == 'done'

    return row


if __name__ == '__main__':
    names = (TASK, BOOK, REGISTRY, 'MEMORY.md', 'docs/TASK_TREE.md')

    for name, roles in snapshots.items():

            Path(row['snapshot']).write_bytes(gzip.compress((before if role == 'before' else after)[name], mtime=0))
    save('publication.json', dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], snapshots=snapshots, **measured))
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in before.items()), 'whole final publication input conservation')

"""Independently rederive source causes and join whole qualified original records."""
import argparse

from cause_common import *

SUCCESS = 'PASS independent complete original primary/raw cause association; every prior scope and native/private unknown retains.\n'


def check(candidate):
    data, identities = inputs()
    primary = module(Path(PLAN['primary']) / 'verify.py')
    models, parser_causes, helpers, products = primary['models']()
    records = {mode: data[mode] for mode in MODES}
    derived = primary['check'](records, models, parser_causes, helpers)
    need(same(derived, data['primary']['proofs']), 'complete independently rederived original primary and acceptance proof')
    context = primary['context']
    source, source_helpers, consumers, source_products = context['source_models']()
    contexts = context['check'](records, data['execution'], source, source_helpers, consumers, source_products)
    need(same(contexts, data['contexts']['proofs']), 'complete independently rederived original source contexts')
    need(set(candidate) == {'schema_version', 'owner', 'revision', 'inputs', 'boundary', 'modes'}
         and type(candidate['schema_version']) is int and candidate['schema_version'] == 1
         and candidate['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and candidate['revision'] == PLAN['revision'], 'closed owned cause product schema')
    need(same(candidate['inputs'], identities), 'whole original qualified cause input custody')
    need(same(candidate['boundary'], boundary(data)), 'whole inherited native and scope boundary')
    need([mode['mode'] for mode in candidate['modes']] == list(MODES), 'complete ordered original mode allocation')
    inventories = {mode['mode']: mode['domains'] for mode in data['raw']['inventories']}
    raw_rows = {(mode['mode'], domain, record['index']): record
                for mode in data['raw']['inventories'] for domain, group in mode['domains'].items()
                for record in group['nonempty']}
    links = {tuple(row['record']): row for row in data['semantic']['semantic_links']['records']}
    inherited = {tuple(row['record']): row for mode in data['semantic']['modes']
                 for domain in mode['domains'].values() for row in domain['records']}
    need(len(links) == len(data['semantic']['semantic_links']['records'])
         and links.keys() == raw_rows.keys() == inherited.keys(), 'complete unique qualified raw semantic membership')
    used, totals = set(), []
    for mi, mode in enumerate(MODES):
        actual_mode, native = candidate['modes'][mi], data[mode]
        need(set(actual_mode) == {'mode', 'domains', 'helpers'} and set(actual_mode['domains']) == set(DOMAINS),
             'complete closed source cause domains')
        counts = {}
        for domain in DOMAINS:
            group = actual_mode['domains'][domain]
            native_rows = native[domain] if domain != 'test_run' else [native['test_run']]
            original = inventories[mode][domain]
            empty = [index for index, row in enumerate(native_rows) if row['error'] == '']
            nonempty = [index for index, row in enumerate(native_rows) if row['error'] != '']
            empty_set = set(empty)
            need(set(group) == {'population', 'empty', 'nonempty', 'records'}
                 and type(group['population']) is int and group['population'] == len(native_rows) == original['population']
                 and same(group['empty'], empty) and same(empty, original['empty_string_members'])
                 and same(group['nonempty'], nonempty) and same(nonempty, [row['index'] for row in original['nonempty']])
                 and same([row['record'] for row in group['records']], [[mode, domain, i] for i in range(len(native_rows))]),
                 'whole ordered nonempty and empty operation allocation')
            for index, (row, observation) in enumerate(zip(group['records'], native_rows, strict=True)):
                key = mode, domain, index
                need(set(row) == {'record', 'source', 'primary', 'observed_primary', 'status', 'native', 'product', 'raw', 'semantic'},
                     'closed complete cause association row')
                expected_source = (models[mode][index] if domain == 'api' else contexts[mi]['parsers'][index] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                message = (models[mode][index]['primary'] if domain == 'api' else parser_causes[index] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                need(same(row['source'], expected_source), 'whole own source argument/helper/parser/caller association')
                need(same(row['primary'], message) and same(row['observed_primary'], observation.get('primary'))
                     and (observation['error'].splitlines()[0] if observation['error'] else None) == message,
                     'whole independently derived own first cause')
                field = 'completed' if domain == 'test_run' else 'accepted'
                authority = 'source_first_cause' if domain in ('api', 'parses') else 'qualified_prior_observation'
                need(same(row['status'], dict(field=field, value=observation[field], authority=authority))
                     and type(row['status']['value']) is int
                     and (authority != 'source_first_cause' or row['status']['value'] == int(message is None)),
                     'typed own source-derived acceptance or retained observation')
                need(same(row['native'], pin(canonical(observation)))
                     and same(row['product'], pin(canonical(observation.get('result')))), 'whole own original native and product association')
                if index in empty_set:
                    need(row['raw'] is None and row['semantic'] is None and key not in raw_rows,
                         'complete empty error has no borrowed raw or semantic member')
                    continue
                used.add(key)
                raw, link, old = raw_rows[key], links[key], inherited[key]
                need(same(row['raw'], raw) and same(old['original'], raw)
                     and raw['body'] == observation['error'] and raw['body_identity'] == pin(observation['error'].encode())
                     and raw['body'].encode() == b''.join(segment['raw'].encode() for segment in raw['segments'])
                     and same(raw['context'], {name: observation[name] for name in ('kind', 'caller', 'helper', 'parse') if name in observation}),
                     'whole own raw body context segments and address lexemes')
                proposed = row['semantic']
                need(isinstance(proposed, dict) and same(proposed['record'], list(key))
                     and proposed['first_cause']['domain'] == domain and type(proposed['first_cause']['index']) is int
                     and proposed['first_cause']['index'] == index and proposed['first_cause']['primary'] == message
                     and same(proposed['context'], raw['context']) and proposed['stack']['body'] == raw['body_identity'],
                     'whole own semantic record cause and raw context')
                forwarding = proposed['forwarding']
                if link['forwarding'] is not None:
                    inner = tuple(link['forwarding']['inner_record'])
                    child = records[inner[0]][inner[1]][inner[2]]
                    relation = link['forwarding']['source_relation']
                    prefix = link['phases'][-1]['classification']['guard_source']['prefix'] + relation['context'] + ' has invalid resolved type: ' + child['error'] + '\n'
                    need(isinstance(forwarding, dict) and same(forwarding, link['forwarding'])
                         and inner[0] == mode and inner[1] == 'api' and same(forwarding['outer_record'], list(key))
                         and forwarding['whole_inner_body'] == child['error'] and raw['body'].startswith(prefix)
                         and forwarding['whole_outer_prefix'] == prefix and relation['inner_body'] == pin(child['error'].encode())
                         and relation['entire_outer_prefix'] == pin(prefix.encode())
                         and forwarding['whole_new_outer_trace'] == raw['body'][len(prefix):]
                         and relation['new_outer_trace'] == pin(raw['body'][len(prefix):].encode()),
                         'whole nested own inner operand outer prefix and new trace')
                else:
                    need(forwarding is None, 'absent nested cause cannot borrow forwarding')
                need(same(proposed, link), 'whole qualified ordered class frame coordinate address and opaque role join')
            counts[domain] = dict(population=len(native_rows), empty=len(empty), nonempty=len(nonempty))
        helper_rows = actual_mode['helpers']
        need(len(helper_rows) == len(source_helpers), 'complete source helper population')
        for source_helper, row, observation in zip(source_helpers, helper_rows, native['helpers'], strict=True):
            index = source_helper['index']
            api = [i for i in source_helper['api_members'] if models[mode][i]['primary'] is not None]
            parses = [i for i in source_helper['parse_members'] if parser_causes[i] is not None]
            need(bool(api) != bool(parses), 'own helper has one failed operation family')
            domain, first = ('api', min(api)) if api else ('parses', parses[0])
            message = models[mode][first]['primary'] if api else parser_causes[first]
            need(set(row) == {'source', 'primary', 'first_record', 'failing_api_members', 'failing_parse_members', 'native'}
                 and same(row['source'], source_helper) and same(row['native'], pin(canonical(observation)))
                 and row['primary'] == message and same(row['first_record'], [mode, domain, first])
                 and same(row['failing_api_members'], api) and same(row['failing_parse_members'], parses),
                 'whole own helper source membership and first failed operation')
            need(index == helper_rows.index(row), 'ordered source helper allocation')
        totals.append(dict(mode=mode, domains=counts, helpers=len(helper_rows)))
    need(used == set(raw_rows), 'every complete original raw semantic cause is consumed exactly once')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], product=pin(canonical(candidate)), inputs=identities,
                allocation=totals, complete_primary=pin(canonical(derived)), complete_contexts=pin(canonical(contexts)),
                boundary=boundary(data))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', type=Path, default=BASE / 'candidate.json.gz')
    parser.add_argument('--save', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(args.candidate.parent == BASE and not args.candidate.is_symlink(), 'ordinary own complete association candidate')
    result = check(product(args.candidate))
    if args.save:
        need(args.candidate == BASE / 'candidate.json.gz', 'only positive native qualification may publish')
        save('association.json', result)
    print(SUCCESS, end='')

"""Qualify complete finite cause association with dated and explicit current roles."""
import argparse
import copy
import stat

from cause_common import *
import controls
import intake
import reader

SUCCESS = 'PASS complete finite independent primary/raw cause association; canonical and cause-parent acceptance remain open.\n'
EXCLUDED = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json'} | {label + suffix for label in ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines')
    for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}


def read(name):
    return json.loads((BASE / name).read_bytes())


def gate(label, command, stdout=None, *, current=False):
    row, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'}
         and set(row) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
         and all(same(row[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'closed complete actual native gate')
    need(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == 0
         and type(row['expected_status']) is int and row['expected_status'] == 0, 'typed actual positive native success')
    need(row['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(row['programmes'], row['programmes_after']), 'whole actual command and programme epoch')
    direct = {name for name in command if '\n' not in name and len(name) < 240 and Path(name).is_file()}
    own = {Path(name).name for name in direct if Path(name).parent == BASE}
    dependencies = {'capture.py'} | own
    if own - {'intake.py'}:
        dependencies.add('cause_common.py')
    if 'controls.py' in own:
        dependencies.add('reader.py')
    for name, entry in row['programmes'].items():
        body = entry['body'].encode() if 'body' in entry else bytes.fromhex(entry['body_hex'])
        need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole actual programme or input body')
        # Enumerated auxiliary own programmes retain their actual dated bodies;
        # only the command and its declared imports carry current-source claims.
        if current and (Path(name).parent != BASE or Path(name).name in dependencies):
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole explicit current command dependency')
    need(type(row['stdout']) is str and type(row['stderr']) is str
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', row['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in row['stderr'], 'unchanged complete native guard terminal')
    if stdout is not None:
        need(row['stdout'] == stdout and row['stderr'].count('\n') == 1, 'whole intended native gate output')
    return row


def contracts():
    original = nodes(intake.git('show', PLAN['revision'] + ':' + TASK))
    active = nodes(intake.overlays()[TASK])
    need(original.keys() == active.keys(), 'whole activation task population')
    for name, block in original.items():
        if name == PLAN['owner']:
            need(field(block, 'Status') == 'pending' and field(active[name], 'Status') == 'active'
                 and active[name] == block.replace(b'  Status: `pending`', b'  Status: `active`', 1), 'only unchanged cause association activates')
        else:
            need(block == active[name], 'every other whole task contract conserves')
    need(field(active[PLAN['parent']], 'Status') == 'active'
         and field(active[PLAN['parent'] + '.1'], 'Status') == 'done'
         and field(active[PLAN['parent'] + '.3'], 'Status') == 'pending', 'complete prerequisite/canonical parent state')
    return {name: {key: field(active[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Status', 'Children')}
            for name in (PLAN['parent'], *(PLAN['parent'] + '.' + str(i) for i in (1, 2, 3)))}


def qualify_controls(candidate):
    terminal = read('controls.json')
    cases = controls.cases(candidate)
    specifications = [('candidate', None, None), *cases]
    need(terminal['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and set(terminal['actuals']) == {name for name, _, _ in specifications},
         'complete positive and separating control population')
    receipts = {}
    for label, mutate, cause in specifications:
        expected = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
        if mutate:
            mutate(expected)
        path = BASE / (label + '.json.gz')
        need(same(product(path), expected), 'whole intended changed candidate and conserved prior products')
        actual, started = read('control-' + label + '-actual.json'), read('control-' + label + '-started.json')
        need(set(started) == {'command', 'expected_status', 'intended_cause', 'candidate', 'programmes'}
             and set(actual) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
             and all(same(actual[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'complete direct native control terminal')
        status = int(mutate is not None)
        need(type(actual['status']) is int and type(actual['expected_status']) is int
             and actual['status'] == actual['expected_status'] == status and actual['intended_cause'] == cause
             and actual['command'] == ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'reader.py'), '--candidate', str(path)]
             and actual['candidate'] == dict(path=str(path), identity=pin(path.read_bytes()))
             and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after']), 'whole intended typed native refusal or positive success')
        for name, entry in actual['programmes'].items():
            need(entry == dict(body=Path(name).read_text(), identity=pin(Path(name).read_bytes())), 'whole control command and dependency source epoch')
        need((actual['stdout'] == '' and actual['stderr'].endswith('ValueError: ' + cause + '\n')) if mutate
             else actual['stdout'] == reader.SUCCESS and actual['stderr'] == '', 'exact first native control refusal or positive output')
        identity = pin(canonical(actual))
        need(identity == terminal['actuals'][label], 'whole retained native separating outcome custody')
        receipts[label] = identity
    return dict(receipts=receipts, condition=terminal['condition'])


def core(*, current=False):
    prior = read('preparation-normal-commit.json')
    need(set(prior) == {'command', 'status', 'stdout', 'stderr'} and type(prior['status']) is int and prior['status'] == 0
         and prior['command'] == ['git', '--no-pager', 'commit', '-F', 'git_message_brief.txt']
         and PLAN['revision'][:9] in prior['stdout'].splitlines()[0]
         and '[doctrine] all doctrine checks passed' in prior['stdout'] + prior['stderr'], 'whole normal preparation commit and hooks')
    source = intake.derive()
    need(same(source, read('source-roles.json')) and same(read('source-before.json'), read('source-after.json')),
         'whole fixed original/current graph and unchanged live source epoch')
    before = read('source-before.json')
    need(before['source'] == pin(canonical(source['publication']))
         and before['overlays'] == {name: pin(body) for name, body in intake.overlays().items()}, 'whole source census role and activation overlays')
    for epoch in ('before', 'after'):
        gate('source-' + epoch, ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'intake.py'), '--' + epoch], intake.SUCCESS, current=current)
    gate('producer', ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'produce.py')],
         'Built complete proposed original primary/raw cause association; independent qualification remains required.\n', current=current)
    gate('independent', ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'reader.py'), '--save'], reader.SUCCESS, current=current)
    gate('controls', ['python3', '-B', str(BASE / 'controls.py')],
         'PASS complete positive and genuine prior-preserving primary/raw association controls.\n', current=current)
    prerequisite = gate('prerequisite', ['python3', '-B', PLAN['preparation'] + '/verify.py'],
         'PASS complete source-bound primary/raw/coordinate/address cause prerequisites; independent cause association remains next.\n', current=current)
    history = gate('root-history', ['git', 'log', '-1', '-S',
        'Independently join every original primary and complete raw cause identity.', '--format=%H %s', '--', 'docs/tasks/'], current=current)
    need(re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40} .+\n', history['stdout']), 'complete owned association obligation history locus')
    candidate = product(BASE / 'candidate.json.gz')
    association = reader.check(candidate)
    need(same(association, read('association.json')), 'whole independently reconstructed native association qualification')
    qualified = qualify_controls(candidate)
    draft = read('guide-draft.json')
    need(draft['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and type(draft['first']['native_status']) is int and draft['first']['native_status'] == 1
         and draft['first']['bytes'] == len((BASE / 'guide-first-draft.txt').read_bytes()) > draft['limit_bytes']
         and type(draft['second']['native_status']) is int and draft['second']['native_status'] == 1
         and draft['second']['bytes'] == len((BASE / 'guide-second-draft.txt').read_bytes()) > draft['limit_bytes']
         and draft['final']['bytes'] == len((BASE / 'guide.txt').read_bytes()) <= draft['limit_bytes'], 'retained over-budget preview and contained final guide')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], source=pin(canonical(source)), prior_commit=pin(canonical(prior)),
        contracts=contracts(), association=association, controls=qualified, prerequisite=pin(canonical(prerequisite)), guide_preview=draft,
        legs=dict(rederive='Complete fixed source/native/product graph, finite source/context/first-cause/acceptance models and whole own empty/raw/class/frame/coordinate/address/nested association.',
                  falsify='Every complete positive and genuine wrong/borrowed/omitted/order/Boolean/native-boundary candidate executes the independent native reader; all original underlying qualified products conserve.',
                  durability='Complete fixed Git sources, matching live source epochs, native programmes/commands/streams, whole positive/hostile products and actual typed outcomes, saved reader and normal commit hooks.'),
        condition=PLAN['condition'], programme_roles='Complete enumerated auxiliary own programmes retain their actual dated bodies; only each command and its declared imports carry current-source authority. The exploratory schema receipt retains its first capture programme separately.')


def catalogue():
    result = {}
    for path in sorted(BASE.iterdir()):
        need(not path.is_symlink() and stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode)
             and path.stat().st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev, 'whole ordinary same-volume flat association archive')
        if path.name not in EXCLUDED:
            result[path.name] = dict(**pin(path.read_bytes()), executable=bool(path.stat().st_mode & 0o111))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--core', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--seal', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--current', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(not (args.core and args.seal), 'one explicit complete association proof role')
    result = core(current=args.current or args.seal)
    if args.core:
        print('PASS complete independent primary/raw cause association core; delivery remains separate.')
    else:
        import publish
        result['publication'] = publish.qualify(current=args.current or args.seal)
        result['external'] = {name: pin(canonical(gate(name, command, current=args.current or args.seal))) for name, command in publish.COMMANDS.items()}
        need('All tests successful' in read('focused-actual.json')['stdout'], 'actual focused regression success')
        need(json.loads(canonical(result)) == result, 'whole proof uses lossless JSON-native containers and values')
        if args.seal:
            save('proof.json', result)
            save('manifest.json', catalogue())
        else:
            need(same(read('proof.json'), result) and same(read('manifest.json'), catalogue()), 'whole immutable saved association proof')
        print(SUCCESS, end='')

"""Finite source-authored contexts, independent of native labels and flags.

This is a model of the exact pinned T1986 source, not a general Perl parser.
"""
import re


def catalog(source):
    helpers, consumers = [], []

    def require(condition, message):
        if not condition:
            raise ValueError(message)

    def location(marker, at_start=False):
        require(source.count(marker) == 1, 'unique complete source context marker: ' + marker)
        offset = source.index(marker) + (0 if at_start else len(marker))
        return ['main', './t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t', source[:offset].count('\n') + 1]

    def consume(label, marker=None, kind=None, helper=None):
        marker = marker or "'" + label + "');"
        caller = location(marker)
        if kind is None:
            calls = list(re.finditer(r'(?<!\w)(is_deeply|is|ok|like|unlike)\(', source[:source.index(marker)]))
            require(calls, 'source assertion call exists')
            kind = calls[-1][1]
        consumers.append(dict(index=len(consumers), kind=kind, label=label, helper=helper, caller=caller))

    def helper(label, marker=None, pattern=None, declaration=None):
        marker = marker or "'" + label + "');"
        caller = location(marker)
        end = source.index(marker) + len(marker)
        start = source.rfind('refuses(', 0, end)
        require(start >= 0, 'source refusal call exists')
        statement = source[start:end]
        # The pinned Perl call COP retains the completed anonymous callback
        # location; the following label argument does not install a new COP.
        closure_end = start + statement.rindex('}')
        caller = ['main', './t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t', source[:closure_end].count('\n') + 1]
        if pattern is None:
            patterns = re.findall(r'qr/((?:\\.|[^/])*)/', statement)
            require(len(patterns) == 1, 'unique source literal helper pattern')
            pattern = patterns[0]
        else:
            require(declaration is not None and source.count(declaration) == 1,
                    'complete own source loop pattern declaration')
            require('qr/' + pattern + '/' in declaration, 'own source helper pattern literal')
        index = len(helpers)
        helpers.append(dict(index=index, label=label, pattern='(?^:' + pattern + ')', caller=caller,
                            source_statement=statement, source_declaration=declaration))
        consume(label + ' refuses', 'ok(!$ok, "$name refuses");', 'ok', index)
        consume(label + ' names the cause in its diagnostic line',
                'like($diagnostic, $pattern, "$name names the cause in its diagnostic line");', 'like', index)

    for label in ('scope validation retains original typed JSON', 'reference validation retains original typed JSON',
                  'copy validation retains original typed JSON', 'known bad full trace contains the caller pattern',
                  'oracle selects the actual message', 'the same false cause cannot satisfy the diagnostic oracle',
                  'input to owner storage accepts resolved alias equivalence',
                  'prepared storage to output contract accepts identity', 'prepared input to output contract accepts identity'):
        consume(label)
    for label in ('copy independently enforces target role', 'whole input target', 'scalar input target'):
        helper(label)
    consume('prepared scalar output target retains allowed role')

def module(path):

join_reader = module(JOIN / 'verify.py')

result_reader = join_reader['result_reader']

identity, digest = result_reader['identity'], result_reader['digest']


def authenticate():
    binding = load(BASE / 'binding.json')
    task = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', binding['revision'] + ':' + binding['task_path']], text=True)
    require(task == binding['task_body'], 'complete committed context task authority')
    require([r['id'] for r in binding['owners']] == [join_reader['PREFIX'] + '3'], 'exact done input/private context prerequisite')
    for row in binding['owners']:
        start = task.index('- ID: `' + row['id'] + '`'); end = task.index('\n- ID:', start + 1)
        require(task[start:end] == row['body'] and '\n  Status: `done`\n' in row['body'], 'whole done context prerequisite body')
    expected = set(load(JOIN / 'binding.json')['archives']) | {str(JOIN), str(SEMANTICS), str(ACTORS)}

        require(manifest == sealed(Path(path)), 'whole context/source prerequisite seal')

def source_models():
    source = load(graph_reader['INPUTS'] / 'binding.json')['sources']['t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t']['body']
