    old = load(SEMANTICS / 'semantics.json')
    require(len(old['helpers']) == 43 and len(products['actors']) == 4, 'complete qualified original operation domain')
    for index, helper in enumerate(helpers):
        prior = old['helpers'][index]['whole_native']
        helper['api_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['apis'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['consumer_members'] = [r['index'] for r in consumers if r['helper'] == index]
        helper['parse_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['actors'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['copy_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['private'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['api_bounds'] = [prior['api_start'], prior['api_end']]
        helper['parse_bounds'] = [prior['parse_start'], prior['parse_end']]
        require(helper['api_members'] == list(range(*helper['api_bounds'])), 'complete own qualified source helper API span')
        require(helper['parse_members'] == list(range(*helper['parse_bounds'])), 'complete own qualified source helper parser span')
        require(helper['consumer_members'] == list(range(*[prior['consumer_start'], prior['consumer_end']])), 'independent source consumer/helper span')
    return source, helpers, consumers, products


def check(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products):
    actor_models = load(ACTORS / 'actor-models.json')
    parser_sources = [actor_models['sources']['local'], actor_models['sources']['imported'], *actor_models['refused_sources']]
    require("'record-value-controls.isf'" in source and "\"$work/imported.isf\"" in source and "'still-refused.isf'" in source, 'exact source-authored filename roles')
    proof = []
    for mode in ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls'):
        native = records[mode]
        require(len(native['helpers']) == 43 and len(native['consumers']) == 125 and len(native['parses']) == 4
                and len(native['api']) == 9283 and len(native['copies']) == 697, 'complete current context operation population')
        for model, actual in zip(helpers, native['helpers']):
            require(same({k: actual[k] for k in ('label', 'pattern', 'caller')},
                         {k: model[k] for k in ('label', 'pattern', 'caller')}), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
            index = model['index']
            for section, label in (('api', 'api'), ('consumers', 'consumer'), ('parses', 'parse')):
                members = model[label + '_members']
                bounds = [actual[label + '_start'], actual[label + '_end']]
                require(all(type(n) is int for n in bounds) and members == list(range(*bounds)), 'whole own source helper operation span')
                require(members == [i for i, row in enumerate(native[section]) if row['helper'] == index], 'complete own source helper operation membership')
            require(model['copy_members'] == [i for i, row in enumerate(native['copies']) if row['helper'] == index], 'complete own source helper private copy membership')
        for model, actual in zip(consumers, native['consumers']):
            require(same({k: actual[k] for k in ('kind', 'label', 'helper', 'caller')},
                         {k: model[k] for k in ('kind', 'label', 'helper', 'caller')}), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
        receipt = next(r for r in execution['modes'] if r['mode'] == mode)
        parsed = []
        for index, actual in enumerate(native['parses']):
            original = products['actors'][index]['whole_native']
            require(same(actual['caller'], original['caller']) and same(actual['helper'], original['helper']), 'own qualified parser caller/helper context')
            arguments = graph_reader['thaw'](actual['before'])
            require(type(arguments) is list and len(arguments) == 2 and type(arguments[1]) is str
                    and arguments[0] == parser_sources[index], 'whole source-authored parser input text/context')
            filename = arguments[1]
            if index == 1:
                # The random basename and historical absolute prefix are opaque
                # retained capture coordinates, not reusable runtime paths.
                suffix = receipt['fixture'] + r'/\.artifacts/tmp/tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+/imported\.isf'
                require(re.search(r'(?:^|/)' + re.escape(receipt['fixture']) + r'/\.artifacts/tmp/tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+/imported\.isf$', filename) is not None,
                        'own imported parser filename role/fixture suffix')
                require("print {$file} '" + actor_models['sources']['shared'] + "';" in source, 'whole source-authored imported package fixture')
            else:
                require(filename == ('record-value-controls.isf' if index == 0 else 'still-refused.isf'), 'exact source-authored logical parser filename')
            require(same(actual['before'], actual['after']), 'whole parser input context readonly')
            members = [r['index'] for r in products['apis'] if r['whole_native']['parse'] == index]
            require(members == list(range(actual['api_start'], actual['api_end']))
                    and members == [i for i, row in enumerate(native['api']) if row['parse'] == index], 'complete own parser API operation span')
            parsed.append(dict(index=index, raw_filename=filename, source_input=identity(arguments[0].encode()),
                               whole_before=digest(actual['before']), caller=actual['caller'], helper=actual['helper'], api_members=members))
        proof.append(dict(mode=mode, source_helpers=helpers, source_consumers=consumers, parsers=parsed,
                          raw_helpers=digest(native['helpers']), raw_consumers=digest(native['consumers']), raw_parsers=digest(native['parses'])))
    return proof


def controls(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products):
    rejected = []

    def reject(name, change, cause):
        bad = copy.deepcopy(records); change(bad)
        try:
            check(bad, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products)
        except ValueError as error:
            require(str(error) == cause, 'wrong intended source-context control cause: ' + name)
            rejected.append(dict(control=name, status=1, error=str(error)))
        else:
            raise ValueError('false-green source-context control: ' + name)

    reject('wrong-helper-label', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(label='whole input target'), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-pattern', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(pattern='(?^:wrong cause)'), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-caller', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0]['caller'].__setitem__(2, 116), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-span', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(consumer_end=12), 'whole own source helper operation span')
    reject('borrow-api-owner', lambda n: n['ordinary']['api'][820].update(helper=1), 'complete own source helper operation membership')
    reject('wrong-consumer-label', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0].update(label='reference validation retains original typed JSON'), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-consumer-kind', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0].update(kind='ok'), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-consumer-caller', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0]['caller'].__setitem__(2, 56), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-parser-source', lambda n: n['ordinary']['parses'][0]['before'][1].__setitem__(0, '(actor wrong)'), 'whole source-authored parser input text/context')
    reject('borrow-parser-fixture', lambda n: n['ordinary']['parses'][1]['before'][1].__setitem__(1, 'imported.isf'), 'own imported parser filename role/fixture suffix')
    reject('omit-helper', lambda n: n['controls']['helpers'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    reject('omit-consumer', lambda n: n['controls']['consumers'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    reject('omit-parser', lambda n: n['controls']['parses'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    return rejected


def main():
    authenticate()
    source, helpers, consumers, products = source_models()
    records = {m: load(result_reader['CAPTURE'] / (m + '.json')) for m in ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls')}
    execution = load(result_reader['CAPTURE'] / 'execution.json')
    result = dict(proofs=check(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products),
                  controls=controls(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products))
    path = BASE / 'proofs.json'
    if path.exists():
        require(same(load(path), result), 'complete saved original source-context/span proof')
    else:
        path.write_text(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('PASS complete finite source-authored helper/consumer/parser contexts and qualified own operation spans. '
          'Raw operands/errors retain; primary/raw-coordinate and consumer-operand truth remain open.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check current class/frame/coordinate/address facts and unrelated source currency."""

import argparse

ROOT = plane.ROOT
HISTORICAL = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006')

BUILD = COMMAND + ' --build .artifacts/class-frame-current-book'
# Dated admission readers import this public stream when validating saved results.

SUCCESS = 'PASS current class/frame facts, complete current source/query allocation and unchanged capacity/source contracts.\n'
EPOCH_REVISION = 'f7bcdaf5e9c2b831b79497dbe7c704dd1fd0c1d9'
EPOCH_CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/coordinate-admission-checks-20261007')
QUESTION = 'why did the class/frame current reader reject unrelated Knowledge Map updates?'
OLD_SCOPE = '''Historical success does not establish current card/query/reader/source currency. Current
publication checks complete core/helper/tooling meanings/question ownership, unique book
guidance, canonical selection/endpoints/bytes/ignore policy, exact current budget and
indexed members. Original destination-locality replay remains required. Explicit factory
output checks remain required for native copied bytes; visual QA stays pending.
'''
NEW_SCOPE = '''Historical success proves no current card/query/reader/source currency. Current checks
complete core/helper/tooling meanings/questions, unique book guidance, canonical
selection/endpoints/bytes/ignore policy, exact budgets and indexed members. Original
destination-locality replay and factory native copied-byte checks remain required;
visual QA stays pending.

The old class/frame current check froze unrelated card bytes/queries. This route
derives complete global source allocation.
'''


def require(condition, cause):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def same(left, right):
    return json.dumps(left, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) == json.dumps(right, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)


def identity(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def historical():
    """Keep the complete sealed programme and its snapshot predicate unchanged."""
    namespace = {'__name__': 'retained_publication', '__file__': str(HISTORICAL / 'verify.py')}
    exec(compile((HISTORICAL / 'verify.py').read_bytes(), str(HISTORICAL / 'verify.py'), 'exec'), namespace)
    require(same(namespace['load'](HISTORICAL / 'manifest.json'), namespace['members']()),
            'complete immutable historical publication seal')
    return namespace


def expected_cards(prior):
    result = {}
    for path, text in prior['model']['cards']().items():
        old = prior['model']['COMMAND']
        require(text.count(old) == 1 and text.count('date: 2026-10-06\n') == 1,
                'unique original current card route and date')
        result[path] = text.replace(old, COMMAND, 1).replace('date: 2026-10-06\n', 'date: 2026-10-07\n', 1)
        if path == prior['TOOLING']:
            require(result[path].count(OLD_SCOPE) == 1, 'complete original tooling current-scope paragraph')
            result[path] = result[path].replace('date: 2026-10-07\n',
                '  - "' + QUESTION + '"\ndate: 2026-10-07\n', 1).replace(OLD_SCOPE, NEW_SCOPE, 1)
            result[path] = epoch_fact.extend(result[path])
            result[path] = public_reference_fact.extend(result[path])
            result[path] = expression_fact.extend(result[path])
    return consumer_fact.cards(cause_fact.cards(raw_fact.cards(observer_fact.cards(address_fact.cards(coordinate_fact.cards(result))))))


def guide(prior):
    book = prior['book']
    result = book['GUIDE'].replace(book['BUILD'], BUILD).replace(book['COMMAND'], COMMAND)
    result = result.replace('Unrelated book\nprogress is permitted by the current reader.',
        'Unrelated book and non-target Knowledge Map progress is permitted. The current\n'
        'reader derives the complete global question allocation and physical census from\n'
        'current canonical sources; the saved historical snapshot keeps its exact epoch.')
    return observer_namespace_fact.guide(observer_fact.guide(address_fact.guide(coordinate_fact.guide(result))))


def sources():
    """Enumerate both canonical scan roots; reject foreign or nonregular inputs.

    The existing finite Git population and canonical-source byte bounds apply
    before reads. No submodule, symlink directory or nested repository is entered.
    """
    result = {}
    for root in ('docs/knowledge', 'docs/decisions'):
        plane.local_parents(ROOT / root / 'endpoint')
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(ROOT / root, followlinks=False):
            base = Path(directory)
            for child in children:
                plane.local_parents(base / child / 'endpoint')
            for name in sorted(files):
                if not name.endswith('.md'):
                    continue
                path = base / name
                require(len(result) < MAX_TRACKED_PATHS, 'bounded canonical source population')
                relative = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
                raw = plane.local_read(path, plane.SOURCE_BYTES)
                raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
                result[relative] = raw
    return dict(sorted(result.items()))


def authority(prior):
    return prior['source_model']()


def current_input(prior, canonical):
    public = prior['public']
    physical = {p: raw for p, raw in canonical.items() if Path(p).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}

    book_budget = next(json.loads(s)['enforcement_ceilings']['bytes_each']
                       for s in registry.decode().splitlines() if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior')
    return dict(cards={p: canonical[p].decode() for p in expected_cards(prior)},
        chapter=plane.local_read(ROOT / prior['CHAPTER'], book_budget).decode(),
        tooling_chapter=plane.local_read(ROOT / prior['TOOLING_CHAPTER'], book_budget).decode(),
        queries=public['queries'](), census=public['metrics'](physical),
        surface=public['authority'](registry), source_members={p: identity(raw) for p, raw in canonical.items()},
        source_budget=next(json.loads(s) for s in registry.decode().splitlines()
                           if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'book_source_manifest'))


def check(record, canonical, prior, declared):
    require(type(record) is dict and set(record) == {
        'cards', 'chapter', 'tooling_chapter', 'queries', 'census', 'surface', 'source_members', 'source_budget'},
        'closed complete current publication input')
    expected = expected_cards(prior)
    require(record['cards'] == expected and all(canonical.get(p) == text.encode() for p, text in expected.items()),
            'complete current target meanings questions metadata and replay routes')
    require(record['chapter'].count(guide(prior)) == 1 and record['chapter'].count(prior['book']['EPOCH']) == 1,
            'unique complete current and retained publication guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(raw_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted raw source guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(coordinate_fact.PARSER_GUIDE) == 1
            and record['tooling_chapter'].count(coordinate_fact.REFERENCE) == 1,
            'complete current coordinate parser and tooling guidance')
    require(record['tooling_chapter'].count(address_fact.REFERENCE) == 1,
            'complete current finite address tooling guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(cause_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted cause source guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(consumer_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted consumer source guidance')
    pins = record['source_members']
    require(type(pins) is dict and all(type(pin) is dict and set(pin) == {'bytes', 'sha256'}
        and type(pin['bytes']) is int and pin['bytes'] >= 0 and type(pin['sha256']) is str
        for pin in pins.values()), 'current source member identity kinds')
    require(same(pins, {p: identity(raw) for p, raw in canonical.items()}),
            'complete independently enumerated current source members')
    physical = {p: raw for p, raw in canonical.items() if Path(p).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}
    prior['public']['within'](record['census'], record['surface'])
    require(same(record['census'], prior['public']['metrics'](physical)), 'complete current physical census')
    require(same(record['surface'], declared['surface']), 'unchanged current collection authority')
    require(type(record['queries']) is dict and set(record['queries']) == {'direct', 'cached'},
            'complete actual current query roles')
    allocation = prior['metadata']['allocation'](canonical)
    target = sorted(prior['metadata']['allocation']({p: t.encode() for p, t in expected.items()})['rows'].splitlines())
    for role, actual in record['queries'].items():
        require(type(actual) is dict and set(actual) == {'command', 'status', 'stdout', 'stderr'},

        require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0, 'actual current query integer success')

        ids = {Path(path).stem for path in expected}

    require(record['tooling_chapter'].count(original) == 1, 'complete canonical source and native build roles')
    for row in plane.expected_rows():
        chapter = record['chapter'] if row['chapter'] == prior['CHAPTER'].stem else record['tooling_chapter']

"""Authenticate admitted finite raw source facts at their original source epochs."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import book_source_references as plane
import record_value_observer_fact as finite
import record_value_observer_namespace_fact as namespace

PREPARATION = Path('docs/audits/raw-canonical-preparation-20261011')
CARD = 'docs/knowledge/record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader.md'
CANDIDATE = {'bytes': 15449, 'sha256': 'ef7b15d1140a3d39a64834cbd815b1a099b643189e4b8085c5dead67e78303ad'}
EXTRAS = {'default-actual.json': {'bytes': 91885,
                         'sha256': '05d444017c103cd6cd1a5a06e4d4dc65a0d65edd397dfb9685b1632032caa732'},
 'default-started.json': {'bytes': 46033,
                          'sha256': '8876aac711d019c9c609ff5c957b7d006b578e600cec10ccde00751d7c744c58'},
 'manifest.json': {'bytes': 10733,
                   'sha256': 'f96ab59e57c9302ed43bc907af6cd85d8babb0e59292c6f7266ebff3f2280b9d'},
 'proof.json': {'bytes': 191324,
                'sha256': 'f426739f810b1ec98313bccd0f47f56cba0e519d90a53b48d85085d18c948757'},
 'seal-actual.json': {'bytes': 91888,
                      'sha256': 'df7d13bccd2ed63a742e3133cc8b839daae224f937ff6292dc5873e7e79d15ca'},
 'seal-started.json': {'bytes': 46036,
                       'sha256': '19d4adb3f94d512368be63c440a5df8e227ff077496368ff5174513fdc14bf5e'},
 'staged-doctrines-actual.json': {'bytes': 119958,
                                  'sha256': '386ec8fa876ffe537ea92b441df53ed22ef417302fbda97a2ada0bbb23fc9161'},
 'staged-doctrines-started.json': {'bytes': 27142,
                                   'sha256': '9b59e7469574402255835e5ff0af1954003dbf33aa9e93db387a96251140b01c'}}
PARENT_SUCCESS = 'PASS complete unchanged raw semantic parent acceptance; canonical and higher native/private scopes remain open.\n'
GUIDE = '''Canonical raw facts qualify finite source joins, nested causes, whole bodies
and controls. Fixed-source replay preserves earlier epochs; full raw closure
remains separate. Recovery refuses unsafe paths/conflicts. Earlier failures and
unknown interrupted peak RSS/first launch diagnostic retain; native/private stay open.

'''


def require(condition, cause):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def admission():
    return json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'candidate.json', CANDIDATE))


def published(candidate):
    before, after = candidate['before'], candidate['after']
    require(candidate['target'] == CARD and finite.identity(before.encode()) == candidate['before_identity']
            and finite.identity(after.encode()) == candidate['after_identity'], 'whole admitted raw candidate bodies')
    require(before.split('---\n', 2)[:2] == after.split('---\n', 2)[:2],
            'all admitted original raw fact questions evidence and probes retain')
    for key, value in candidate['proposed'].items():
        require(type(value) is int and type(candidate['previous'][key]) is int
                and value <= candidate['previous'][key], 'non-growing admitted raw candidate')
    require(after.count('date: 2026-10-10\n') == 1, 'exact original raw fact date')
    # This admission's date changes without changing any capacity dimension.
    return after.replace('date: 2026-10-10\n', 'date: 2026-10-11\n', 1)


def cards(previous):
    candidate = admission()
    require(CARD in previous and previous[CARD] == candidate['before'], 'whole predecessor raw meanings and routes')
    result = dict(previous)
    result[CARD] = published(candidate)
    return result


def preparation():
    manifest = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'manifest.json', EXTRAS['manifest.json']))
    declared, modes = {}, {}
    for name, entry in manifest.items():
        require(Path(name).name == name and type(entry) is dict
                and set(entry) == {'bytes', 'sha256', 'executable'} and type(entry['executable']) is bool,
                'closed complete raw preparation member')
        declared[name] = {k: entry[k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
        modes[name] = entry['executable']
    require(not set(declared).intersection(EXTRAS), 'distinct raw preparation seal and external receipt roles')
    declared.update(EXTRAS)
    modes.update({name: False for name in EXTRAS})
    plane.local_parents(plane.ROOT / PREPARATION / 'endpoint')
    namespace.check_tree(plane.ROOT / PREPARATION, declared)
    require(all(bool((plane.ROOT / PREPARATION / name).stat().st_mode & 0o111) == mode
                for name, mode in modes.items()), 'complete raw preparation executable modes')
    return declared


def source_census(source):
    """Check the complete dated Git graph without comparing it to later live code."""
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', 'ls-tree',
                             '-r', '-z', source['revision'], '--', *source['roots']],
                            cwd=plane.ROOT, capture_output=True)
    require(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete original raw fixed source selection')
    entries = {}
    for record in result.stdout.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        header, name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = header.decode().split()
        path = name.decode()
        plane.relative(path)
        require(kind == 'blob' and mode in ('100644', '100755') and path not in entries,
                'ordinary unique original raw fixed source member')
        entries[path] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    require(set(entries) == set(source['members'])
            and all(entry == {k: source['members'][name][k] for k in ('mode', 'oid')}
                    for name, entry in entries.items()), 'complete original raw fixed Git object population')
    directories = sorted({str(parent) for name in entries for parent in Path(name).parents if str(parent) != '.'})
    require(directories == source['directories'], 'complete original raw source directory graph')
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'], cwd=plane.ROOT,
                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for name, entry in sorted(entries.items()):
            expected = source['members'][name]
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode() + b'\n')
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            require(len(header) == 3 and header[0].decode() == entry['oid'] and header[1] == b'blob'
                    and type(expected['bytes']) is int and int(header[2]) == expected['bytes'],
                    'complete original raw source blob header')
            remaining = expected['bytes']
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            while remaining:
                chunk = process.stdout.read(min(1048576, remaining))
                require(chunk, 'complete original raw source body')
                digest.update(chunk)
                remaining -= len(chunk)
            require(process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n' and digest.hexdigest() == expected['sha256'],
                    'whole original raw fixed source bytes')
        process.stdin.close()
        require(process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0 and process.stdout.read(1) == b'',
                'complete original raw source Git terminal')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    return finite.identity(encoded(source))


def check_checkpoint(actual, source):
    require(type(actual) is dict and set(actual) == {
        'revision', 'cwd', 'command', 'source', 'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'after', 'condition'},
        'closed complete admitted raw checkpoint')
    require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0, 'actual admitted raw checkpoint integer success')
    require(actual['revision'] == '2ca3774542dc776e534930c139b43042344140cd'
            and actual['cwd'] == '.artifacts/raw-canonical-preparation-20261011/source-view-v3'
            and actual['command'] == ['python3', '-B', 'docs/audits/raw-semantic-parent-closure-20261011/verify.py'],
            'complete original raw checkpoint source role and command')
    require(actual['source'] == actual['after'] == source, 'whole conserved original raw checkpoint source')
    require(actual['stdout'] == PARENT_SUCCESS and actual['stderr'] == '', 'complete actual original raw checkpoint terminal')


def authenticate():
    declared = preparation()
    candidate = admission()
    published(candidate)
    source = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'source-v3.json', declared['source-v3.json']))
    original = source_census(source)
    actual = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'parent-checkpoint-v3-actual.json', declared['parent-checkpoint-v3-actual.json']))
    check_checkpoint(actual, original)
    proof = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'proof.json', EXTRAS['proof.json']))
    require(proof['source'] == original and proof['actual'] == finite.identity(encoded(actual))
            and proof['candidate'] == candidate, 'complete admitted raw proof and candidate association')
    require(proof['prerequisite']['source_revision'] == 'e42845fc43a61b2da76d5ad3fb5b4158c80765ff'
            and proof['prerequisite']['archive_revision'] == '2ca3774542dc776e534930c139b43042344140cd',
            'original e428 and later raw archive source conditions retain')
    return dict(preparation=declared, source=original, checkpoint=finite.identity(encoded(actual)),
                candidate=CANDIDATE, prerequisite=proof['prerequisite'],
                scope='Complete admitted finite raw source joining and original committed source/native evidence authentication. No fresh original semantic execution, native/private measurement or later historical-programme currency is claimed.')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Restore missing audit gate streams from explicit, unchanged committed receipts."""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import secrets
import stat
import subprocess

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def relative(value, allow_dot=False):
    require(type(value) is str and value and '\\' not in value and '\x00' not in value
            and '\n' not in value and '\r' not in value, 'ordinary relative path text')
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    require(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..', '.git'}.intersection(path.parts)
            and path.as_posix() == value and (value != '.' or allow_dot),
            'canonical repository-relative path')
    return Path(value)


def local(path):
    """Read-only preflight; never create a directory or follow a link."""
    current = REPO
    device = REPO.stat().st_dev
    for index, part in enumerate(path.parts):
        current = current / part
        require(not current.is_symlink(), 'symlink boundary refused')
        if current.exists():
            info = current.lstat()
            require(info.st_dev == device, 'same-volume boundary required')
            require(index == len(path.parts) - 1 or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode),
                    'ordinary directory ancestor required')
            if stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
                require(not os.path.lexists(current / '.git'), 'nested Git boundary refused')
    return current


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        require(key not in result, 'duplicate receipt object key')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def committed_receipts(names):
    result = []
    for name in names:
        path = relative(name)
        require(len(path.parts) == 4 and path.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and path.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        descriptor = os.open(local(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'rb') as stream:
            before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_dev == REPO.stat().st_dev,
                    'ordinary same-volume committed receipt file required')
            raw = stream.read()
            after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
            require((before.st_ino, before.st_dev, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) ==
                    (after.st_ino, after.st_dev, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
                    and len(raw) == before.st_size, 'complete stable committed receipt read')
        native = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), '--no-replace-objects',
                                 'show', 'HEAD:' + name], capture_output=True)
        require(type(native.returncode) is int and native.returncode == 0
                and native.stderr == b'' and native.stdout == raw,
                'complete receipt must match committed HEAD bytes')
        records = json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        result.append((name, records))
    return result


def plan(receipts, root='.'):
    """Validate every source, target and existing body before any filesystem write."""
    root_path = relative(root, allow_dot=True)
    require(local(root_path).is_dir(), 'existing ordinary destination root required')
    targets = {}
    for name, records in receipts:
        source = relative(name)
        require(len(source.parts) == 4 and source.parts[:2] == ('docs', 'audits')
                and source.name == 'checks.json', 'explicit audit checks receipt required')
        namespace = source.parts[2]
        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', namespace) is not None,
                'ordinary audit namespace required')
        require(type(records) is dict and records, 'complete named gate receipt object')
        for label, row in records.items():
            require(type(label) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9-]+', label) is not None
                    and type(row) is dict and type(row.get('status')) is int,
                    'complete typed terminal gate required')
            for stream in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
                require(type(row.get(stream)) is str and type(row.get(stream + '_path')) is str,
                        'complete stream text and path required')
                path = relative(row[stream + '_path'])
                expected = Path('.artifacts') / namespace / 'checks' / label / (stream + '.txt')
                require(path == expected, 'stream path must match its declared audit gate')
                body = row[stream].encode('utf-8')
                target = root_path / path
                key = target.as_posix()
                if key in targets:
                    require(targets[key]['body'] == body, 'contradictory duplicate stream target')
                else:
                    targets[key] = dict(path=target, body=body)
    for row in targets.values():
        target = local(row['path'])
        row['present'] = target.exists()
        if row['present']:
            info = target.lstat()
            require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1,
                    'existing stream must be an ordinary unshared file')
            require(target.read_bytes() == row['body'], 'existing stream bytes conflict')
    return [targets[name] for name in sorted(targets)]


@contextlib.contextmanager
def parent_directory(path):
    """Open each directory without following links, including during installation."""
    flags = os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW
    descriptors = [os.open(REPO, flags)]
    device = os.fstat(descriptors[0]).st_dev
    try:
        for part in path.parts:
            parent = descriptors[-1]
            try:
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                os.mkdir(part, mode=0o700, dir_fd=parent)
                child = os.open(part, flags, dir_fd=parent)
            descriptors.append(child)
            require(os.fstat(child).st_dev == device, 'same-volume directory required at installation')
            try:
                os.stat('.git', dir_fd=child, follow_symlinks=False)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            else:
                raise ValueError('nested Git boundary refused at installation')
        yield descriptors[-1]
    finally:
        for descriptor in reversed(descriptors):
            os.close(descriptor)


def install(rows):
    created = []
    for row in rows:
        if row['present']:
            continue
        path, body = row['path'], row['body']
        with parent_directory(path.parent) as directory:
            temporary = '.restore-stream-' + secrets.token_hex(16)
            descriptor = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW,
                                 0o600, dir_fd=directory)
            try:
                with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'wb') as stream:
                    stream.write(body)
                    stream.flush()
                    os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                # A complete body becomes visible atomically; an existing target is never replaced.
                os.link(temporary, path.name, src_dir_fd=directory, dst_dir_fd=directory,
                        follow_symlinks=False)
                created.append(path.as_posix())
            finally:
                os.unlink(temporary, dir_fd=directory)
    return created


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--receipts', nargs='+', required=True,
                        help='explicit committed docs/audits/NAMESPACE/checks.json sources')
    parser.add_argument('--root', default='.', help='existing ordinary repository-relative destination root')
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true', help='require all exact streams without writing')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipts = committed_receipts(args.receipts)
    rows = plan(receipts, args.root)
    if args.check:
        require(all(row['present'] for row in rows), 'complete streams not yet materialized')
        created = []
    else:
        created = install(rows)
    after = plan(receipts, args.root)
    require(all(row['present'] for row in after), 'complete exact stream installation required')
    print(json.dumps(dict(root=args.root, sources=args.receipts, created=created,
        streams=[dict(path=row['path'].as_posix(), bytes=len(row['body']),
                      sha256=hashlib.sha256(row['body']).hexdigest()) for row in after],
        condition='Exact committed text only; no reader execution, status reinterpretation or native/private qualification.'),
        sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except (ValueError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        raise SystemExit('gate-stream-recovery: ' + str(error))

"""Permanent filesystem and receipt controls for missing-only stream recovery."""
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('stream_recovery', REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
SOURCE = 'docs/audits/test-gates/checks.json'


def records(label='one', text='exact\n'):
    return {label: dict(status=0, stdout=text, stderr='',
        stdout_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stdout.txt',
        stderr_path='.artifacts/test-gates/checks/' + label + '/stderr.txt')}


class StreamRecovery(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        base = recovery.local(Path('.artifacts/gate-stream-tests'))
        base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='case-', dir=base)
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        self.folder = REPO / self.root

    def census(self):
        return {p.relative_to(self.folder).as_posix(): (p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else None)
                for p in self.folder.rglob('*') if not p.is_symlink()}

    def refused(self, candidate, reason, sources=None):
        before = self.census()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, reason):
            recovery.plan(sources or [(SOURCE, candidate)], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), before)

    def test_exact_empty_stream_and_idempotence(self):
        source = records(text='unicode: \u03bb\r\nterminal space \n')
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(recovery.install(rows)), 2)
        self.assertTrue(all(r['present'] for r in recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)))
        before = self.census()
        self.assertEqual(recovery.install(recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), before)
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']).read_bytes(), source['one']['stdout'].encode())
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stderr_path']).read_bytes(), b'')
        self.assertFalse(any('.restore-stream-' in p.name for p in self.folder.rglob('*')))

    def test_conflict_is_refused_before_creating_other_targets(self):
        source = records('aaa') | records('zzz')
        target = self.folder / source['zzz']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.write_bytes(b'conflict')
        self.refused(source, 'existing stream bytes conflict')
        self.assertFalse((self.folder / source['aaa']['stdout_path']).parent.exists())

    def test_identical_duplicates_conserve(self):
        source = records()
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source), (SOURCE, copy.deepcopy(source))], self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(rows), 2)

    def test_contradictory_duplicates_refuse(self):
        source = records()
        self.refused(source, 'contradictory duplicate', [(SOURCE, source), (SOURCE, records(text='different'))])

    def test_missing_stream_text(self):
        source = records()
        del source['one']['stderr']
        self.refused(source, 'complete stream text')

    def test_missing_terminal(self):
        source = records()
        del source['one']['status']
        self.refused(source, 'complete typed terminal')

    def test_boolean_terminal(self):
        source = records()
        source['one']['status'] = False
        self.refused(source, 'complete typed terminal')

    def test_nonzero_terminal_is_preserved_as_text(self):
        source = records()
        source['one']['status'] = 255
        source['one']['stderr'] = 'actual original refusal\n'
        recovery.install(recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root))
        self.assertEqual((self.folder / source['one']['stderr_path']).read_text(), 'actual original refusal\n')
        self.assertEqual(source['one']['status'], 255)

    def test_unsafe_paths_refuse(self):
        for path in ('/outside/stdout.txt', '../stdout.txt', '.git/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts//test-gates/checks/one/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/test-gates/checks/one/../stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/foreign/checks/one/stdout.txt',
                     '.artifacts/test-gates/checks/another/stdout.txt'):
            with self.subTest(path=path):
                source = records()
                source['one']['stdout_path'] = path
                self.refused(source, 'relative path|declared audit gate')

    def test_symlink_ancestor_refuses(self):
        destination = self.folder / 'elsewhere'
        destination.mkdir()
        (self.folder / '.artifacts').symlink_to(destination, target_is_directory=True)
        self.refused(records(), 'symlink boundary')

    def test_symlink_target_refuses(self):
        source = records()
        target = self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.symlink_to(self.folder / 'absent')
        self.refused(source, 'symlink boundary')

    def test_nested_git_marker_refuses(self):
        # A dummy marker is sufficient; no second Git repository is created or modified.
        target = self.folder / '.artifacts'
        target.mkdir()
        (target / '.git').write_text('fixture boundary marker\n')
        self.refused(records(), 'nested Git boundary')

    def test_non_directory_ancestor_refuses_before_writes(self):
        (self.folder / '.artifacts').write_bytes(b'ordinary file')
        self.refused(records(), 'ordinary directory ancestor')

    def test_existing_hardlink_refuses(self):
        source = records()
        target = self.folder / source['one']['stdout_path']
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        original = self.folder / 'shared'
        original.write_text(source['one']['stdout'])
        os.link(original, target)
        self.refused(source, 'ordinary unshared file')

    def test_install_never_replaces_a_racing_target(self):
        source = records()
        rows = recovery.plan([(SOURCE, source)], self.root)
        target = self.folder / rows[0]['path'].relative_to(self.root)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        target.write_bytes(b'concurrent writer')
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            recovery.install(rows)
        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), b'concurrent writer')
        self.assertFalse(any('.restore-stream-' in p.name for p in self.folder.rglob('*')))

    def test_duplicate_json_keys_refuse(self):
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'duplicate receipt object key'):
            json.loads('{"status":0,"status":255}', object_pairs_hook=recovery.unique_object)

    def test_nonregular_receipt_refuses_without_reading(self):
        fifo = self.folder / 'receipt-fifo'
        os.mkfifo(fifo)
        with patch.object(recovery, 'local', return_value=fifo):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'ordinary same-volume committed receipt'):
                recovery.committed_receipts([SOURCE])
        self.assertEqual(fifo.stat().st_size, 0)

    def test_real_committed_receipt_cli_check_and_replay(self):
        command = ['python3', '-B', str(REPO / 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py'),
                   '--receipts', 'docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json', '--root', self.root]
        before = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(before.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn('complete streams not yet materialized', before.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(self.census(), {})
        first = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((first.returncode, first.stderr), (0, ''))
        result = json.loads(first.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(result['created'])
        source = recovery.committed_receipts(['docs/audits/raw-association-acceptance-20261011/checks.json'])
        expected = recovery.plan(source, self.root)
        self.assertEqual(len(result['streams']), len(expected))
        second = subprocess.run(command + ['--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
        third = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual((second.returncode, second.stderr, third.returncode, third.stderr), (0, '', 0, ''))
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(third.stdout)['created'], [])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Save each complete native guard terminal outside the guarded process tree."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/original-consumer-parent-acceptance-20261012')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
             'scripts/record_value_raw_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_consumer_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_cause_fact.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'}
    names.update(str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py'))
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--expect', type=int, choices=(0, 1), default=0)
    parser.add_argument('label')
    parser.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.command or not args.label or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-' for c in args.label):
        raise ValueError('explicit ordinary recovery gate and command')
    command = ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *args.command]
    epoch = instruments(args.command)
    folder = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / args.label
    # The public boundary checker validates the output route without creating it.
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'
    started = dict(command=command, programmes=epoch, expected_status=args.expect,
        stdout_path=str(stdout), stderr_path=str(stderr),
        condition='Complete native terminal writer outside unchanged guard; an expected refusal is not successful original replay.')
    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)
    with stdout.open('xb', buffering=0) as out, stderr.open('xb', buffering=0) as err:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command))
    save(args.label + '-actual.json', actual)
    print(args.label, 'actual native status', result.returncode, flush=True)
    if type(result.returncode) is not int or result.returncode != args.expect or epoch != actual['programmes_after']:
        raise SystemExit(1)

SUCCESS = 'PASS complete original and original-consumer source epochs, native custody and independent membership.\n'


def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own read-only fixed Git result')
    return result.stdout


def derive():
    fact.preparation()
    original = json.loads((fact.PREPARATION / 'source-v3.json').read_bytes())
    fact.source_census(original)
    prior = json.loads((Path(PLAN['canonical_parent']) / 'source-roles.json').read_bytes())

    roots = sorted(name for name in selected if not any(name.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if name != other))
    entries = {}
    for record in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', PLAN['revision'], '--', *roots).rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        header, raw_name = record.split(b'\t', 1)

             'unique ordinary complete publication source member')

    changed = {name: dict(original=old, publication=entries[name]) for name, old in original['members'].items()
               if old != entries[name]}

def namespace(root):
    entries = {}
    listing = git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', PLAN['revision'], '--', root).rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0')
    for row in listing:
        header, raw_name = row.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = header.decode().split()
        name = raw_name.decode()
        need(Path(name).parent == Path(root) and kind == 'blob' and mode in ('100644', '100755')
             and name not in entries, 'complete flat ordinary committed canonical prerequisite')
        entries[name] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid)
    census = subprocess.run(['rg', '--files', '--hidden', '--no-ignore', '--', root], capture_output=True, text=True)
    need(census.returncode == 0 and census.stderr == '' and sorted(census.stdout.splitlines()) == sorted(entries),
         'whole independent canonical prerequisite membership')
    bodies = fixed(entries)
    for name, body in bodies.items():
        info = Path(name).lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev
             and bool(info.st_mode & 0o111) == (entries[name]['mode'] == '100755')
             and Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole same-volume committed canonical prerequisite body/mode')
    return {name: dict(**entries[name], **pin(body)) for name, body in bodies.items()}


def public():
    retained = json.loads((BASE / 'integration-contract.json').read_bytes())['retained_dependencies']
    bodies = fixed(retained)

         'all twelve maintained helper and source interfaces retain')

    need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole unchanged maintained canonical factory')

    previous = sys.path[:]
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
        exec(compile(body, name, 'exec'), result)
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = previous
    return result


@contextlib.contextmanager
def isolated_meaning():
    root = PLAN['meaning']
    namespace(root)
    old_plan = json.loads(fixed([root + '/plan.json'])[root + '/plan.json'])
    roots = (root, *(old_plan[role] for role in ('helper', 'remaining', 'join')))
    names = {path.stem for folder in roots for path in Path(folder).glob('*.py')} | {'capture'}
    previous = {name: sys.modules[name] for name in names if name in sys.modules}
    previous_path = sys.path[:]
    try:
        for name in names:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.path.insert(0, root)
        yield importlib.import_module('reader'), importlib.import_module('controls')
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = previous_path
        for name in names:
            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        sys.modules.update(previous)


def meanings(candidate=None):

def isolated_source():

    previous = {name: sys.modules[name] for name in names if name in sys.modules}

def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def same(left, right):
    return canonical(left) == canonical(right)


def nodes(body):
    starts = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n', body, re.M))
    result = {row[1].decode(): body[row.start():starts[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(starts) else len(body)]
              for i, row in enumerate(starts)}
    need(len(result) == len(starts), 'unique complete canonical task graph')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1].decode() if match else None


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'whole read-only fixed canonical Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def fixed(names):
    names = list(names)
    request = b''.join((PLAN['revision'] + ':' + name + '\n').encode() for name in names)
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=request, capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete fixed canonical source batch')
    stream, sources = io.BytesIO(result.stdout), {}
    for name in names:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'whole declared canonical source header')
        body = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        need(len(body) == int(header[2]) and stream.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole canonical source body and EOF')
        sources[name] = body
    need(stream.read(1) == b'' and len(sources) == len(names), 'complete unique canonical source domain')
    return sources


def canonical_sources():
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', 'docs/knowledge', 'docs/decisions').decode().splitlines()
    return fixed(name for name in names if name.endswith('.md'))


def metrics(sources):
    rows = [dict(bytes=len(body), lines=body.count(b'\n'), width=max(map(len, body.splitlines()), default=0)) for body in sources.values()]
    return dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_total=sum(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                bytes_each=max(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_each=max(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                line_bytes_each=max(row['width'] for row in rows))


def load_product(name):
    raw = gzip.decompress((BASE / name).read_bytes())
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical compressed preparation product')
    return value


def save_product(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain first complete canonical preparation product')
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(value), mtime=0))

def check(candidate):

         and type(candidate['schema_version']) is int, 'closed complete original-consumer schema')
    need(same({key: candidate[key] for key in header}, header), 'whole unchanged original consumer source descendant and boundary contract custody')
    public = data['public']
    fact = public['consumer_fact']
    admitted = fact.published(candidate['admission'])
    need(admitted.encode() == data['canonical'][PLAN['target']], 'whole admitted unchanged canonical consumer publication')
    source = interfaces.source_contracts(candidate['source_contracts'])
    means = interfaces.meanings(candidate['meanings'])
    qualified_path = PLAN['meaning'] + '/qualification.json'
    need(same(means['qualification'], json.loads(fixed([qualified_path])[qualified_path])), 'whole freshly rederived complete original consumer meanings')
    links = source_meaning_links(candidate, source, means)
    public['check'](candidate['current'], data['canonical'], data['prior'], public['authority'](data['prior']))

        admission=fact.authenticate(), source_contracts=source['qualification'], meanings=means['qualification'], links=links,
        canonical=pin(canonical(header['canonical'])), current=pin(canonical(candidate['current'])),
        failures={role: pin(canonical(row)) for role, row in candidate['failures'].items()},
        boundary=PLAN['condition'], assumptions=header['assumptions'])


def source_meaning_links(candidate, source, meanings):
    assertions = source['candidate']['assertions']
    rows = candidate['links']
    modes = ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls')
    join = meanings['candidate']['children']['join']['modes']
    need([mode['mode'] for mode in join] == list(modes) and type(rows) is list
         and len(rows) == len(assertions) * len(modes), 'complete original source operand truth link domain')
    indexed = {}
    keys = {'mode', 'index', 'role', 'context', 'source', 'native', 'meaning', 'basis', 'operand', 'outcome'}
    for row in rows:
        need(type(row) is dict and set(row) == keys and type(row['index']) is int
             and row['mode'] in modes and type(row['outcome']) is int and row['outcome'] in (0, 1),
             'closed typed complete original consumer link')
        key = row['mode'], row['index']
        need(key not in indexed, 'unique original mode source assertion link')
        indexed[key] = row
    qualified = []
    for index, assertion in enumerate(assertions):
        role = 'remaining' if assertion['context']['helper'] is None else 'helper'
        for mode, original in zip(modes, join, strict=True):
            row = original['consumers'][index]
            value = row['meaning']
            need(type(row['index']) is int and row['index'] == index and row['role'] == role
                 and same(row['source_contract'], assertion) and same(value['source_assertion'], assertion),
                 'whole independently admitted original source to consumer meaning join')
            need(type(row['outcome']) is type(value['outcome']) is int and row['outcome'] == value['outcome']
                 and same({key: row['native'][key] for key in value['operand']}, value['operand']),
                 'whole independently rederived typed original operand and comparison outcome')
            wanted = dict(mode=mode, index=index, role=role, context=assertion['context'], source=pin(canonical(assertion)),
                native=pin(canonical(row['native'])), meaning=pin(canonical(value)), basis=pin(canonical({name: part for name, part in value.items() if name not in ('operand', 'outcome', 'source_assertion')})),
                operand=value['operand'], outcome=value['outcome'])
            need((mode, index) in indexed and same(indexed[(mode, index)], wanted),
                 'whole independently rederived source-derived original consumer link')
            qualified.append(dict(mode=mode, index=index, role=role, source=wanted['source'], meaning=wanted['meaning'],
                operand=pin(canonical(wanted['operand'])), outcome=wanted['outcome']))
    need(len(indexed) == len(qualified), 'every source meaning operand truth link consumed exactly once')
    return dict(population=len(qualified), bindings=qualified,
        condition='Every whole original source expression/context binds its independently rederived typed meaning/operand/outcome. Native flags supply no independent truth; original Storable/synthetic/private limits retain.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', default='candidate.json.gz')
    parser.add_argument('--save', action='store_true')

import gzip
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys

def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def same(left, right):
    return canonical(left) == canonical(right)


def nodes(body):
    starts = list(re.finditer(rb'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n', body, re.M))
    result = {row[1].decode(): body[row.start():starts[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(starts) else len(body)]
              for i, row in enumerate(starts)}
    need(len(result) == len(starts), 'unique complete canonical task graph')
    return result


def field(block, name):
    match = re.search(rb'^  ' + name.encode() + rb': `(.*)`$', block, re.M)
    return match[1].decode() if match else None


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'whole read-only fixed canonical Git protocol')
    return result.stdout


def fixed(names):
    names = list(names)
    request = b''.join((PLAN['revision'] + ':' + name + '\n').encode() for name in names)
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'], input=request, capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete fixed canonical source batch')
    stream, sources = io.BytesIO(result.stdout), {}
    for name in names:
        header = stream.readline().split()
        need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'whole declared canonical source header')
        body = stream.read(int(header[2]))
        need(len(body) == int(header[2]) and stream.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole canonical source body and EOF')
        sources[name] = body
    need(stream.read(1) == b'' and len(sources) == len(names), 'complete unique canonical source domain')
    return sources


def canonical_sources():
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', 'docs/knowledge', 'docs/decisions').decode().splitlines()
    return fixed(name for name in names if name.endswith('.md'))


def metrics(sources):
    rows = [dict(bytes=len(body), lines=body.count(b'\n'), width=max(map(len, body.splitlines()), default=0)) for body in sources.values()]
    return dict(files=len(rows), bytes_total=sum(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_total=sum(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                bytes_each=max(row['bytes'] for row in rows), lines_each=max(row['lines'] for row in rows),
                line_bytes_each=max(row['width'] for row in rows))


def load_product(name):
    raw = gzip.decompress((BASE / name).read_bytes())
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(raw == canonical(value), 'whole canonical compressed preparation product')
    return value


def save_product(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    need(not path.exists(), 'retain first complete canonical preparation product')
    path.write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(value), mtime=0))


def public():
    retained = json.loads((BASE / 'integration-contract.json').read_bytes())['retained_dependencies']
    bodies = fixed(retained)
    need(all(pin(body) == retained[name] and Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in bodies.items()),
         'all twelve unchanged maintained source interfaces')
    name = 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py'
    body = fixed([name])[name]
    need(Path(name).read_bytes() == body, 'whole unchanged current canonical factory')
    result = {'__name__': 'fixed_original_association_current_factory', '__file__': name}
    previous = sys.path[:]
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
        exec(compile(body, name, 'exec'), result)
    finally:
        sys.path[:] = previous
    return result

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

BASE = Path('docs/audits/original-context-cause-consumer-association-20261012')


def pin(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()


def save(name, value):
    path = BASE / name
    if path.exists():
        raise ValueError('retain first complete recovery record: ' + name)
    path.write_bytes(canonical(value))


def instruments(command):
    names = {str(BASE / 'capture.py'), 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py',
             't/python/test_record_value_gate_streams.py', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
             'scripts/record_value_raw_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_consumer_fact.py', 'scripts/record_value_cause_fact.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'}
    plan = json.loads((BASE / 'plan.json').read_bytes())
    names.update(str(BASE / name) for name in ('plan.json', 'book-review.json', 'guide.txt',
        'integration-contract.json', 'admission-normal-commit.json', 'activation-task.gz',
        'activation-memory.gz', 'activation-index.gz', 'input-contracts.json', 'input-contracts-initial.json',
        'interface-review.json', 'activation-task-initial.gz', 'development-initial-programmes.json',
        'typed-equality-repair.json', 'capture-typed-repair-expansion.json',
        'capture-candidate-input-expansion.json'))
    names.update(str(path) for path in BASE.glob('*.py'))
    for role in ('admission', 'context', 'cause', 'consumer'):
        names.update(str(path) for path in Path(plan[role]).glob('*.py'))
    names.update(arg for arg in command if '\n' not in arg and len(arg) < 240 and Path(arg).is_file())
    result = {}
    for name in sorted(names):
        raw = Path(name).read_bytes()
        try:
            body = dict(body=raw.decode('utf-8'))
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            body = dict(body_hex=raw.hex())
        result[name] = dict(**body, identity=pin(raw))
    return result


def candidate_inputs(command):
    result = {}
    if '--candidate' in command:
        index = command.index('--candidate')
        if index + 1 >= len(command):
            raise ValueError('explicit native candidate input')
        name = command[index + 1]
        path = BASE / name
        if Path(name).name != name or not name.endswith('.json.gz') or path.is_symlink():

    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('recovery', 'scripts/restore_record_value_gate_streams.py')
    recovery = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(recovery)
    recovery.local(folder)
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    stdout, stderr = folder / 'stdout.txt', folder / 'stderr.txt'

    save(args.label + '-started.json', started)

    actual = dict(**started, status=result.returncode, stdout=stdout.read_text(), stderr=stderr.read_text(),
                  programmes_after=instruments(args.command), candidate_inputs_after=candidate_inputs(args.command))

def mutate(candidate, row):
    action, path = row['action'], row['path']
    if action == 'retain':
        return
    parent, key = get(candidate, path[:-1]), path[-1]
    old = parent[key]
    if action == 'set':
        parent[key] = copy.deepcopy(row['value'])
    elif action == 'pop':
        need(type(old) is list and old, 'genuine nonempty omission target')
        old.pop()
    elif action == 'reverse':
        need(type(old) is list and len(old) > 1, 'genuine ordered separating target')
        old.reverse()
    elif action == 'increment':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer separating target')
        parent[key] = old + 1
    elif action == 'float':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer identity separating target')
        parent[key] = float(old)
    elif action == 'string':
        need(type(old) is int, 'typed integer operand separating target')
        parent[key] = str(old)
    elif action == 'truncate':
        need(type(old) is str and old, 'whole nonempty string separating target')
        parent[key] = old[:-1]
    else:
        raise ValueError('undeclared separating operation')

from association_inputs import *


def operation(data, mode, domain, index):
    native = records(data[mode], domain)[index]
    cause = cause_mode(data, mode)['domains'][domain]['records'][index]
    contexts = context_mode(data, mode)
    helper = native.get('helper')
    parser = index if domain == 'parses' else native.get('parse')
    return dict(record=[mode, domain, index], native=pin(canonical(native)),
        cause=pin(canonical(cause)), source=cause['source'], context=context(native),
        helper_context=None if helper is None else pin(canonical(contexts['source_helpers'][helper])),
        parser_context=None if parser is None else pin(canonical(contexts['parsers'][parser])),
        api_record=[mode, 'api', native['api']] if domain == 'copies' and native['api'] is not None else None,
        primary=cause['primary'], status=cause['status'], product=cause['product'],
        raw=cause['raw'], semantic=cause['semantic'])


def origin(data, mode, row):
    meaning, index = row['meaning'], row['index']
    helper = row['source_contract']['context']['helper']
    qualified = cause_mode(data, mode)
    if helper is not None:
        first = qualified['helpers'][helper]['first_record']
        cause = qualified['domains'][first[1]]['records'][first[2]]
        return dict(kind='source-helper-first-failure', helper=helper, first_record=first,
                    first_source=meaning['first_source'], cause=pin(canonical(cause)),
                    primary=meaning['primary'], source_helper=meaning['source_helper'])
    source = meaning['origin']
    kind = source['kind']
    if kind in ('readonly-authored-json', 'qualified-own-source-api'):
        api = source['api']
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, record=[mode, 'api', api],
            cause=pin(canonical(qualified['domains']['api']['records'][api])),
            source_product=pin(canonical(data['products']['apis'][api])))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-actor-detached-copy':
        copy_index = source['qualified_test_copy']['index']
        witness = next(value for value in data['copy_inputs']['rows'] if value['index'] == copy_index)
        proof = next(value for value in data['copy_proofs']['proofs']
                     if value['mode'] == mode and value['kind'] == 'returned' and value['original_index'] == copy_index)
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, actor=source['actor'],
            parser_record=[mode, 'parses', source['actor']], copy_record=[mode, 'copies', copy_index],
            source_actor=pin(canonical(data['actors']['actors']['local'])),
            copy_input=pin(canonical(witness)), provider_proof=pin(canonical(proof)))
    if kind == 'whole-authored-type-width':
        return dict(kind=kind, model=source, name=source['name'],
                    authored_type=pin(canonical(data['authored']['types'][source['name']])))
    need(kind == 'synthetic-authored-first-line-and-opaque-original-trace', 'complete producer consumer origin cases')
    return dict(kind=kind, model=source, opaque_trace=data[mode]['consumers'][3]['actual'],
                source_scope=pin(canonical(row['source_contract']['source_scope'])))


def propose(data):
    modes = []
    for mode in MODES:
        ctx, causes = context_mode(data, mode), cause_mode(data, mode)
        operations = {domain: [operation(data, mode, domain, index)
                              for index in range(len(records(data[mode], domain)))] for domain in DOMAINS}
        helpers = []
        for helper in causes['helpers']:
            source = helper['source']
            helpers.append(dict(index=source['index'], source=source, cause=pin(canonical(helper)),
                first_record=helper['first_record'], primary=helper['primary'],
                operations={domain: [[mode, domain, index] for index in source[key]]
                            for domain, key in (('api', 'api_members'), ('copies', 'copy_members'), ('parses', 'parse_members'))},
                consumers=[[mode, 'consumers', index] for index in source['consumer_members']]))
        parsers = []
        for parser in ctx['parsers']:
            index = parser['index']
            parsers.append(dict(index=index, source=parser,
                operation=pin(canonical(operations['parses'][index])),
                api_operations=[[mode, 'api', index] for index in parser['api_members']]))
        consumers = []
        for row in consumer_mode(data, mode)['consumers']:
            index, value = row['index'], row['meaning']
            consumers.append(dict(index=index, source_context=ctx['source_consumers'][index],
                source_contract=pin(canonical(row['source_contract'])), native=pin(canonical(row['native'])),
                meaning=pin(canonical(value)), role=row['role'], operand=value['operand'], outcome=value['outcome'],
                truth_authority='admitted source-derived typed comparison', origin=origin(data, mode, row)))
        modes.append(dict(mode=mode, operations=operations, helpers=helpers, parsers=parsers, consumers=consumers))
    return dict(header(data), modes=modes)

                task_names=task_names, book_names=book_names, task_metrics=measured_tasks,

def qualify(current=False):
    row = json.loads((BASE / 'publication.json').read_bytes())
    need(row['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and set(row['snapshots']) == set(NAMES), 'whole owned publication domain')
    before, after = {}, {}
    for name, roles in row['snapshots'].items():
        need(set(roles) == {'before', 'after'}, 'whole publication role pair')
        for role, entry in roles.items():
            path = Path(entry['snapshot'])
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.name.startswith('publication-' + role + '-')
                 and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink(), 'ordinary owned whole source snapshot')
            body = gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole snapshot identity')
            (before if role == 'before' else after)[name] = body
        if current:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == after[name], 'whole current publication')
    wanted, measured = transformation(before)
    need(wanted == after and all(row[key] == value for key, value in measured.items()), 'whole reconstructed publication')
    first, last = nodes(before[TASK]), nodes(after[TASK])
    need(first.keys() == last.keys(), 'whole task membership retains')
    for name, block in first.items():
        if name == PLAN['owner']:
            need(all(field(block, key) == field(last[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
                 and field(last[name], 'Status') == 'done', 'unchanged complete closed association contract')
        else:
            need(block == last[name], 'every unrelated whole task block retains')
    need(field(last[PLAN['parent']], 'Status') == 'active'
         and all(field(last[PLAN[name]], 'Status') == 'pending' for name in ('acceptance', 'full_alias')),
         'canonical/parent/full-alias closure remains separate')
    return row


if __name__ == '__main__':
    before = {name: Path(name).read_bytes() for name in NAMES}
    need(all(before[name] == body for name, body in intake.overlays().items()), 'whole qualified activation metadata')
    after, measured = transformation(before)
    snapshots = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(NAMES):
