from preparation_common import *
import intake

NAMES = (TASK, BOOK, REGISTRY, 'MEMORY.md', 'docs/TASK_TREE.md')
COMMANDS = {
    'focused': ['prove', '-v', 't/2066-record-value-current-publication.t',
        't/2067-record-value-gate-streams.t', 't/1549-task-tree-integrity-doctrine.t',
        't/1636-claim-verification-doctrine.t', 't/1638-claim-verification-dispositions.t',
        't/1303-isf-public-live-book-paths-audit.t', 't/1305-isf-book-feature-matrix-audit.t'],
    'book': ['mdbook', 'build', 'docs/book'],
    'native': ['python3', '-B', 'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', '--build', 'docs/book/book'],
    'size': ['scripts/check_live_document_size.sh'],
    'claims': ['scripts/check_claim_verification.pl'],
    'inventory-write': ['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl', '--write'],
    'inventory': ['scripts/check_claim_verification_inventory.pl']}


def transformation(before):
    original = nodes(before[TASK])
    owner = PLAN['owner']
    block = original[owner]
    need(field(block, 'Status') == 'active' and field(block, 'Commit') == 'pending',
         'exact active owned canonical preparation')
    evidence = (
        'Complete non-growing original join canonical preparation binds fixed committed 192c9dae source-first associations and every unchanged original parent/descendant contract. '
        'The complete independent association meaning is freshly rederived; source/current epochs conserve every original model, native/control/failure/repair product. '
        'Every old canonical fact/question/probe and unrelated source retains. Only the reviewed joined-source statement, equivalent prose contractions and fact date change prospectively; maintained production and all twelve helper bodies remain unchanged. '
        'The first oversized static projection remains a rejected read-only design measurement, not a native verification failure. Both prior actual0/declared1 primitive-kind false greens remain failed with exact typed repairs and corrected native first refusals. '
        'Genuine whole prospective source/meaning/omission/kind/false-green/native-promotion/scope/capacity controls reach intended actual native first refusals. '
        'Claim legs are complete independent original association and unchanged contract/fact/route/capacity rederivation; genuinely changed native candidates separating borrowed, omitted, malformed, false-green or promoted meanings; and committed complete source/input/native/failure/repair/programme/publication epochs with sealed/default recovery and normal hooks. '
        'Explicit engineering equivalence review is not universal natural-language proof. Qualified old source-derived causes and typed truths are shared premises; native passed flags never supply truth. '
        'Current source/query/book/native/focused/size/claim/inventory/staged/normal delivery closes only preparation. Original assumptions and dated execution/native/private/provider/formatter/encoding/hidden identity limits retain. '
        'Production, original parents, full alias and broader product/semantic/cold/permanent/host-native/private/visual/HIAL/full-CI/push remain separate.')
    changed = block.replace(b'  Status: `active`', b'  Status: `done`', 1)
    changed, count = re.subn(rb'^  Verification: `.*`$', ('  Verification: `' + evidence + '`').encode(), changed, count=1, flags=re.M)
    need(count == 1, 'exact owned preparation verification field')
    changed = changed.replace(b'  Commit: `pending`',
        ('  Commit: `' + owner + ': prepare non-growing original join canonical meanings`').encode(), 1)
    changed = changed.rstrip() + (
        '\n  Acceptance Checklist (enforced):\n'
        '  - [x] **ROOT CAUSE (WHY + WHERE)** — git log -S locates the unchanged full original join requirement. Complete independently qualified context/cause/coordinate/consumer associations need a source-bound, non-growing canonical proposal before production admission; existing fact/question/probe and native/private boundaries remain mandatory.\n'
        '  - [x] **ADDRESSED (verified)** — Independent unchanged association reexecution and complete paragraph/source/contract/capacity correspondence qualify only reviewed finite joined meanings. Genuine native wrong-source, omission, typed-kind, false-green, scope, promotion and capacity candidates reach intended first refusals. All prior first failures and exact repairs remain bound.\n'
        '  - [x] **NO REGRESSION** — All tests successful in focused publication/stream/task/claim/disposition/book audits. Current source/query/capacity/book/native/size/claim/inventory, sealed/default saved reconstruction, staged scripts/check_doctrines.sh and normal hooks qualify preparation with unchanged production and all twelve maintained helper interfaces.\n\n').encode()
    need(before[TASK].count(block) == 1, 'whole unique owned preparation beforeimage')
    task = before[TASK].replace(block, changed, 1)
    review = json.loads((BASE / 'book-review.json').read_bytes())
    book = before[BOOK]
    anchor, guide = review['anchor'].encode(), (BASE / 'guide.txt').read_bytes()
    need(book.count(anchor) == 1, 'unique retained independent association notice')
    book = book.replace(anchor, anchor + b'\n' + guide, 1)
    for old, new in review['book_compactions']:
        need(book.count(old.encode()) == 1, 'whole reviewed prose beforeimage')
        book = book.replace(old.encode(), new.encode(), 1)
    need(len(before[BOOK]) == review['before_bytes'] and len(book) == review['after_bytes']
         <= 292485, 'reviewed bounded chapter growth and unchanged ceiling')
    for command in re.findall(rb'```(?:bash|sh)\n(.*?)```', before[BOOK], re.S):
        need(book.count(command) == before[BOOK].count(command), 'all original runnable commands retain')
    for line in before[BOOK].splitlines():
        if re.search(rb'[0-9]', line):
            need(book.splitlines().count(line) == before[BOOK].splitlines().count(line),
                 'all original numeric claims/dispositions retain')
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision']).decode().splitlines()
    task_names = sorted(name for name in names if re.fullmatch(r'docs/tasks/(?:[^/]+|segments/[^/]+/[^/]+)\.md', name))
    book_names = sorted(name for name in names if re.fullmatch(r'docs/book/src/[^/]+\.md', name))
    tasks, books = fixed(task_names), fixed(book_names)
    measured_before = metrics(books)
    tasks[TASK], books[BOOK] = task, book
    measured_tasks, measured_books = metrics(tasks), metrics(books)
    rows = list(map(json.loads, before[REGISTRY].splitlines()))
    for row in rows:
        if row.get('surface_id') == 'task_evidence':
            for key, value in measured_tasks.items():
                need(row['enforcement_ceilings'][key] is None or value <= row['enforcement_ceilings'][key],
                     'all unchanged task ceilings')
                row['transition']['max_growth'][key] = max(0, value + row['transition']['ratchet_step'][key] - row['baseline'][key])
        elif row.get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior':
            keys = ('files', 'bytes_total', 'lines_total')
            row['reference_contract']['aggregate_change'] = dict(
                authority_id='ORIGINAL-JOIN-CANONICAL-PREPARATION-20261012', owner=owner,
                baseline={key: measured_before[key] for key in keys},
                delta={key: measured_books[key] - measured_before[key] for key in keys},
                rationale='Document the reviewed prospective non-growing canonical original join and separate production/parent acceptance. Every existing prose fact, command, numeric claim, encoding disposition, native/private limit and unchanged ceiling retains.')
    memory = before['MEMORY.md'].decode()
    need(memory.count(owner + '` (active)') == 1, 'exact active preparation pointer')
    memory = memory.replace(owner + '` (active)', PLAN['publication'] + '` (pending)', 1)
    memory = re.sub(r'^- next_action:.*$', '- next_action: Publish the committed reviewed non-growing original join canonical proposal; preserve all facts, contracts and native/private limits.', memory, flags=re.M)
    memory = re.sub(r'^- in_flight_background:.*$', '- in_flight_background: None; derive preparation receipts under docs/audits/original-join-canonical-preparation-20261012.', memory, flags=re.M)
    marker = b'context/cause/consumer canonical preparation active.'
    need(before['docs/TASK_TREE.md'].count(marker) == 1, 'unique owned index marker')
    index = before['docs/TASK_TREE.md'].replace(marker, b'context/cause/consumer canonical publication next.', 1)
    return {TASK: task, BOOK: book, REGISTRY: b''.join(canonical(row) for row in rows),
            'MEMORY.md': memory.encode(), 'docs/TASK_TREE.md': index}, dict(
                task_names=task_names, book_names=book_names, task_metrics=measured_tasks,
                book_before=measured_before, book_after=measured_books)


def qualify(current=False):
    row = json.loads((BASE / 'publication.json').read_bytes())
    need(row['owner'] == PLAN['owner'] and set(row['snapshots']) == set(NAMES), 'whole owned publication domain')
    before, after = {}, {}
    for name, roles in row['snapshots'].items():
        need(set(roles) == {'before', 'after'}, 'whole publication role pair')
        for role, entry in roles.items():
            path = Path(entry['snapshot'])
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.name.startswith('publication-' + role + '-')
                 and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink(), 'ordinary owned whole source snapshot')
            body = gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes())
            need(pin(body) == entry['identity'], 'whole snapshot identity')
            (before if role == 'before' else after)[name] = body
        if current:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == after[name], 'whole current publication')
    wanted, measured = transformation(before)
    need(wanted == after and all(row[key] == value for key, value in measured.items()), 'whole reconstructed publication')
    first, last = nodes(before[TASK]), nodes(after[TASK])
    need(first.keys() == last.keys(), 'whole task membership retains')
    for name, block in first.items():
        if name == PLAN['owner']:
            need(all(field(block, key) == field(last[name], key) for key in ('Goal', 'Acceptance', 'Children'))
                 and field(last[name], 'Status') == 'done', 'unchanged complete closed preparation contract')
        else:
            need(block == last[name], 'every unrelated whole task block retains')
    need(field(last[PLAN['parent']], 'Status') == 'active'
         and all(field(last[PLAN[name]], 'Status') == 'pending' for name in ('publication', 'acceptance', 'full_alias')),
         'canonical/parent/full-alias closure remains separate')
    return row


if __name__ == '__main__':
    before = {name: Path(name).read_bytes() for name in NAMES}
    need(all(before[name] == body for name, body in intake.overlays().items()), 'whole qualified activation metadata')
    after, measured = transformation(before)
    snapshots = {}
    for i, name in enumerate(NAMES):
        snapshots[name] = {}
        for role, body in (('before', before[name]), ('after', after[name])):
            path = BASE / ('publication-' + role + '-' + str(i) + '.gz')
            need(not path.exists(), 'retain first whole publication source')
            snapshots[name][role] = dict(snapshot=str(path), identity=pin(body))
    need(not (BASE / 'publication.json').exists(), 'retain first whole publication record')
    for name, roles in snapshots.items():
        for role, entry in roles.items():
            Path(entry['snapshot']).write_bytes(gzip.compress((before if role == 'before' else after)[name], mtime=0))
    save('publication.json', dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], snapshots=snapshots, **measured))
    need(all(Path(name).read_bytes() == body for name, body in before.items()), 'whole final beforeimage conservation')
    for name, body in after.items():
        Path(name).write_bytes(body)
    print('Published only preparation evidence; canonical production and original parents remain separate.')

def check(candidate, ctx=None):
    ctx = context() if ctx is None else ctx
    sources, data = ctx['sources'], ctx['data']
    keys = {'schema_version', 'owner', 'revision', 'target', 'before', 'after', 'before_identity', 'after_identity',
            'correspondence', 'review', 'input_identities', 'contracts', 'scope', 'canonical_members', 'queries',
            'previous', 'proposed', 'authority'}
    need(type(candidate) is dict and set(candidate) == keys and type(candidate['schema_version']) is int
         and candidate['schema_version'] == 1 and candidate['owner'] == PLAN['owner']
         and candidate['revision'] == PLAN['revision'] and candidate['target'] == TARGET,
         'closed typed complete original-join canonical schema')
    need(same(candidate['input_identities'], data['identities']), 'complete own committed association input identities')
    need(same(candidate['contracts'], data['contracts']), 'every unchanged original parent and descendant contract')
    need(same(candidate['scope'], scope(data)), 'complete original assumptions failures native private and scope boundaries')
    need(same(candidate['canonical_members'], {name: pin(body) for name, body in sources.items()}),
         'every own canonical source membership and whole body')
    review = json.loads((BASE / 'proposal-review.json').read_bytes())
    need(set(review) == {'after', 'before', 'changes', 'condition', 'first_projection', 'header', 'meanings', 'target'}
         and same(review['changes'], DECLARED) and review['target'] == TARGET,
         'independent finite joined meaning and equivalent contraction review')
    before, after = sources[TARGET].decode(), sources[TARGET].decode()
    for old, new in DECLARED:
        need(after.count(old) == 1, 'unique independent original fact allocation')
        after = after.replace(old, new, 1)
    need(same(review['before'], dict(body=before, identity=pin(before.encode())))
         and same(review['after'], dict(body=after, identity=pin(after.encode()))), 'whole reviewed proposal before and after')
    first = review['first_projection']
    first_body = before
    for old, new in first['changes']:
        need(first_body.count(old) == 1, 'unique first static projection change')
        first_body = first_body.replace(old, new, 1)
    need(first_body == first['body'] and same(first['identity'], pin(first_body.encode()))
         and len(first_body.encode()) > len(before.encode()), 'first oversized static projection remains rejected without native-failure promotion')
    need(candidate['before'] == before and same(candidate['before_identity'], pin(before.encode())),
         'whole own original target beforeimage')
    need(candidate['after'] == after and same(candidate['after_identity'], pin(after.encode())),
         'whole independently allocated joined meanings and retained facts')
    before_header = before.split('---\n', 2)[1].replace('date: 2026-10-11\n', 'date: 2026-10-12\n', 1)
    need(after.split('---\n', 2)[1] == before_header, 'all original questions identifiers probes and header fields retain')
    for line in before.splitlines():
        if re.search(r'[0-9]', line) and not line.startswith('date: '):
            need(after.splitlines().count(line) == before.splitlines().count(line), 'all original numeric fact lines retain')
    parts = before.split('\n\n')
    rows = candidate['correspondence']
    need(type(rows) is list and len(rows) == len(parts), 'complete original paragraph population')
    consumed = []
    for index, part in enumerate(parts):
        wanted, used = part, []
        for i, (old, new) in enumerate(DECLARED):
            if old in part:
                need(part.count(old) == 1, 'unique own paragraph meaning allocation')
                wanted = wanted.replace(old, new, 1)
                used.append(i)
        expected = dict(index=index, before=part, after=wanted, change_ids=used,
                        kind='unchanged' if part == wanted else 'reviewed_join_or_equivalent')
        need(same(rows[index], expected), 'whole typed ordered original paragraph and reviewed meaning correspondence')
        consumed.extend(used)
    need(sorted(consumed) == list(range(len(DECLARED))) and '\n\n'.join(row['after'] for row in rows) == after
         and same(candidate['review'], review), 'every reviewed change consumed once and complete review retains')
    cards = {name: body for name, body in sources.items() if Path(name).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}
    previous = metrics(cards)
    cards[TARGET] = after.encode()
    measured = metrics(cards)
    need(same(candidate['previous'], previous) and same(candidate['proposed'], measured),
         'complete typed independently measured non-growing capacity')
    need(same(candidate['authority'], ctx['authority']), 'unchanged whole collection and card capacity authority')
    for key, value in measured.items():
        row = ctx['authority']
        allowed = min(row['enforcement_ceilings'][key], row['baseline'][key] + row['transition']['max_growth'][key])
        need(type(value) is int and value <= previous[key] and value <= allowed, 'non-growing unchanged canonical allowance: ' + key)
    need(len(after.encode()) <= len(before.encode()), 'non-growing whole canonical target')
    allocation = ctx['prior']['metadata']['allocation'](sources)['rows']
    prospective = dict(sources, **{TARGET: after.encode()})
    need(same(ctx['prior']['metadata']['allocation'](prospective)['rows'], allocation),
         'complete prospective fact and question ownership conserves')
    need(same(candidate['queries'], ctx['current']['queries'])
         and set(candidate['queries']) == {'direct', 'cached'}
         and all(type(row['status']) is int and row['status'] == 0 and same(row['stdout'], allocation)
                 for row in candidate['queries'].values()), 'whole actual distinct direct and cached canonical question allocation')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], candidate=pin(canonical(candidate)),
        association=data['association'], contracts=pin(canonical(data['contracts'])),
        source_members=pin(canonical(candidate['canonical_members'])), previous=previous, proposed=measured,
        correspondence=pin(canonical(rows)), scope=scope(data), condition=PLAN['condition'])

    parser.add_argument('--candidate', default='candidate.json.gz')

def read(name):

def bodies(row):
    for name, entry in row.items():
        raw = entry['body'].encode() if 'body' in entry else bytes.fromhex(entry['body_hex'])
        need(pin(raw) == entry['identity'], 'whole native programme/input body identity')

def gate(label, command, current=False, development=False, status=0):
    actual, started = read(label + '-actual.json'), read(label + '-started.json')
    extra = {'candidate_inputs'} if 'candidate_inputs' in started else set()
    need(set(started) == {'command', 'programmes', 'expected_status', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'condition'} | extra
         and set(actual) == set(started) | {'status', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'programmes_after'}
             | ({'candidate_inputs_after'} if extra else set())
         and all(same(actual[key], value) for key, value in started.items()), 'closed complete native gate')
    need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == status
         and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == status
         and actual['command'] == ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh', '--', *command]
         and same(actual['programmes'], actual['programmes_after']), 'typed native declared/observed outcome and conserved source epoch')
    if extra:
        need(same(actual['candidate_inputs'], actual['candidate_inputs_after']), 'whole native candidate input conservation')
        for name, identity in actual['candidate_inputs'].items():
            path = Path(name)
            need(path.parent == BASE and path.suffix == '.gz' and not path.is_symlink()
                 and pin(path.read_bytes()) == identity, 'whole saved native candidate body')
    own = {name: entry for name, entry in actual['programmes'].items() if Path(name).parent == BASE and Path(name).suffix == '.py'}
    if development:

        need(same(own, epoch['programmes']) and pin((BASE / (label + '-actual.json')).read_bytes()) == epoch['actual'],
             'complete dated development source/native epoch')
    else:
        need(same(own, read('formal-programmes.json')['programmes']), 'whole frozen formal programme membership and bodies')
    for name, raw in bodies(actual['programmes']):
        if current and not development:
            need(Path(name).read_bytes() == raw, 'whole current native programme/input body')
    stream = Path('.artifacts') / BASE.name / 'checks' / label
    need(actual['stdout_path'] == str(stream / 'stdout.txt') and actual['stderr_path'] == str(stream / 'stderr.txt')
         and re.match(r'ram-guard: PID [0-9]+; host [0-9]+\.[0-9]+%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; poll 2s\n', actual['stderr'])
         and 'ram-guard: terminating PID tree' not in actual['stderr'], 'unchanged guard and repository-local full terminal routes')
    return pin(canonical(actual))


def stream_namespace():
    """Compare every complete fixed archived body without accumulating negative cases."""
    root = PLAN['association']
    names = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', PLAN['revision'], '--', root).decode().splitlines()
    need(names == sorted(str(path) for path in Path(root).iterdir()), 'complete fixed flat association namespace')
    result = {}
    process = subprocess.Popen(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'cat-file', '--batch'],
                               stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    try:
        for name in names:
            info = Path(name).lstat()
            need(Path(name).parent == Path(root) and stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                 and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev, 'ordinary same-volume fixed association namespace')
            process.stdin.write((PLAN['revision'] + ':' + name + '\n').encode())
            process.stdin.flush()
            header = process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(len(header) == 3 and header[1] == b'blob', 'whole fixed association blob header')
            remaining = int(header[2])
            import hashlib
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with Path(name).open('rb') as local:
                while remaining:
                    size = min(1048576, remaining)
                    body = process.stdout.read(size)
                    need(len(body) == size and local.read(size) == body, 'whole streamed fixed association source bytes')
                    digest.update(body)
                    remaining -= size
                need(local.read(1) == b'' and process.stdout.read(1) == b'\n', 'whole fixed association EOF')
            result[name] = dict(bytes=int(header[2]), sha256=digest.hexdigest(), executable=bool(info.st_mode & 0o111))
        process.stdin.close()
        need(process.stdout.read(1) == b'' and process.stderr.read() == b'' and process.wait() == 0,
             'whole native read-only streamed Git source result')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.kill()
            process.wait()
    manifest = json.loads(Path(root, 'manifest.json').read_bytes())
    excluded = {'proof.json', 'manifest.json'} | {label + suffix for label in
        ('seal', 'default', 'staged-doctrines') for suffix in ('-started.json', '-actual.json')}
    need(same(manifest, {Path(name).name: value for name, value in result.items() if Path(name).name not in excluded}),
         'complete committed source proof native control failure repair catalogue')
    return result

def canonical(value):

def cases(candidate):

    semantic = 'whole own semantic record cause and raw context'

        ('omit-helper', lambda value: value['modes'][0]['helpers'].pop(), 'complete source helper population'),

import argparse

finally:

OVERLAYS = {TASK: 'activation-task.md.gz', 'MEMORY.md': 'activation-memory.md.gz',
            'docs/TASK_TREE.md': 'activation-index.md.gz'}
SUCCESS = 'PASS complete original and current publication source epochs, native custody and independent membership.\n'


def need(value, cause):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def git(*args):
    result = subprocess.run(['git', '--no-replace-objects', '--literal-pathspecs', *args], capture_output=True)
    need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == b'', 'complete own read-only fixed Git result')
    return result.stdout


def derive():
    fact.preparation()
    original = json.loads((fact.PREPARATION / 'source-v3.json').read_bytes())
    fact.source_census(original)
    prior = json.loads((Path(PLAN['preparation']) / 'source-roles.json').read_bytes())
    selected = set(prior['publication']['roots']) | {PLAN['preparation']}
    roots = sorted(name for name in selected if not any(name.startswith(other + '/') for other in selected if name != other))
    entries = {}
    for record in git('ls-tree', '-r', '-z', PLAN['revision'], '--', *roots).rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        header, raw_name = record.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, kind, oid = header.decode().split()
        name = raw_name.decode()
        plane.relative(name)
        need(kind == 'blob' and mode in ('100644', '100755') and name not in entries,
             'unique ordinary complete publication source member')
        old = original['members'].get(name)
        if old and old['oid'] == oid and old['mode'] == mode:
            entries[name] = old
        else:
            body = git('cat-file', 'blob', oid)
            entries[name] = dict(mode=mode, oid=oid, **pin(body))
    need(set(original['members']) <= set(entries), 'every complete original source member retains')
    changed = {name: dict(original=old, publication=entries[name]) for name, old in original['members'].items()
               if old != entries[name]}
    code = {name for name in changed if Path(name).suffix in ('.py', '.pl', '.pm', '.sh', '.js', '.t')}
    need(code <= {'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py', 't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'},
         'only explicit maintained publication instruments advance; original semantic programmes retain')
    source = dict(revision=PLAN['revision'], roots=roots, members=entries,
        directories=sorted({str(parent) for name in entries for parent in Path(name).parents if str(parent) != '.'}))
    fact.source_census(source)
    return dict(original=original, publication=source, changed=changed,
        condition='Original complete reader/source/native roles retain their fixed 2ca and earlier e428 conditions. Current canonical production is separately bound to the clean publication/cleanup commit. No later original-programme currency or native/private recapture is inferred.')


def overlays(after=False):
    return {name: gzip.decompress((BASE / snapshot).read_bytes()) for name, snapshot in OVERLAYS.items()}


def live(roles, after=False):
    source = roles['publication']
    activation = overlays(after)
    expected = {name: {key: row[key] for key in ('bytes', 'sha256')} for name, row in source['members'].items()}
    expected.update({name: pin(body) for name, body in activation.items()})
    members = set()
    for root_name in source['roots']:
        root = Path(root_name)
        plane.local_parents(plane.ROOT / root / 'endpoint' if root.is_dir() else plane.ROOT / root)
        if root.is_dir():
            declared = {str(Path(name).relative_to(root)): row for name, row in expected.items()
                        if name.startswith(root_name + '/')}
            namespace.check_tree(root, declared)
            result = subprocess.run(['rg', '--files', '--hidden', '--no-ignore', '--', root_name], capture_output=True, text=True)
            need(result.returncode == 0 and result.stderr == '', 'actual independent complete source directory census')
            members.update(result.stdout.splitlines())
        else:
            need(root_name in expected, 'declared complete source file root')
            members.add(root_name)
    need(members == set(expected), 'whole independent fixed/current source file membership')
    for name in sorted(members):
        path = Path(name)
        info = path.lstat()
        need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_dev == Path.cwd().stat().st_dev
             and bool(info.st_mode & 0o111) == (source['members'][name]['mode'] == '100755'),
             'ordinary same-volume complete current source mode')
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open('rb') as stream:
            while chunk := stream.read(1048576):
                digest.update(chunk)
        after = path.stat()
        need((info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns) ==
             (after.st_dev, after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns)
             and dict(bytes=after.st_size, sha256=digest.hexdigest()) == expected[name],
             'whole fixed publication or declared activation source bytes')
    return dict(source=pin(canonical(source)), overlays={name: pin(body) for name, body in activation.items()},
                members=sorted(members), condition=roles['condition'])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--before', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--after', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    need(args.before != args.after, 'one explicit source census epoch')

"""Build a proposed cause join from separately qualified retained products."""
from cause_common import *


def proposed():
    data, identities = inputs()
    raw = {(mode['mode'], domain, record['index']): record
           for mode in data['raw']['inventories'] for domain, group in mode['domains'].items()
           for record in group['nonempty']}
    semantics = {tuple(row['record']): row for row in data['semantic']['semantic_links']['records']}
    modes = []
    for mi, mode in enumerate(MODES):
        native = data[mode]
        primary = data['primary']['proofs'][mi]
        context = data['contexts']['proofs'][mi]
        domains = {}
        for domain in DOMAINS:
            members = native[domain] if domain != 'test_run' else [native['test_run']]
            records, empty, nonempty = [], [], []
            for index, actual in enumerate(members):
                key = mode, domain, index
                source = (primary['complete_source_API_primary_models'][index] if domain == 'api' else
                          context['parsers'][index] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                message = (source['primary'] if domain == 'api' else primary['parsers'][index]['primary'] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                error = actual['error']
                (nonempty if error else empty).append(index)
                status_field = 'completed' if domain == 'test_run' else 'accepted'
                records.append(dict(record=list(key), source=source, primary=message,
                    observed_primary=actual.get('primary'),
                    status=dict(field=status_field, value=actual[status_field],
                        authority='source_first_cause' if domain in ('api', 'parses') else 'qualified_prior_observation'),
                    native=pin(canonical(actual)), product=pin(canonical(actual.get('result'))),
                    raw=raw.get(key), semantic=semantics.get(key)))
            domains[domain] = dict(population=len(members), empty=empty, nonempty=nonempty, records=records)
        helpers = []
        for source, cause, actual in zip(context['source_helpers'], primary['helpers'], native['helpers'], strict=True):
            domain = 'api' if cause['failing_api_members'] else 'parses'
            member = (cause['failing_api_members'] or cause['failing_parse_members'])[0]
            helpers.append(dict(source=source, primary=cause['primary'], first_record=[mode, domain, member],
                failing_api_members=cause['failing_api_members'], failing_parse_members=cause['failing_parse_members'],
                native=pin(canonical(actual))))
        modes.append(dict(mode=mode, domains=domains, helpers=helpers))
    return dict(schema_version=1, owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], inputs=identities,
                boundary=boundary(data), modes=modes)

                for record in group['nonempty']}
    links = {tuple(row['record']): row for row in data['semantic']['semantic_links']['records']}
    inherited = {tuple(row['record']): row for mode in data['semantic']['modes']

         and links.keys() == raw_rows.keys() == inherited.keys(), 'complete unique qualified raw semantic membership')

             'complete closed source cause domains')

        for domain in DOMAINS:
            group = actual_mode['domains'][domain]

            need(set(group) == {'population', 'empty', 'nonempty', 'records'}

            for index, (row, observation) in enumerate(zip(group['records'], native_rows, strict=True)):
                key = mode, domain, index

                expected_source = (models[mode][index] if domain == 'api' else contexts[mi]['parsers'][index] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                message = (models[mode][index]['primary'] if domain == 'api' else parser_causes[index] if domain == 'parses' else None)
                need(same(row['source'], expected_source), 'whole own source argument/helper/parser/caller association')
                need(same(row['primary'], message) and same(row['observed_primary'], observation.get('primary'))
                     and (observation['error'].splitlines()[0] if observation['error'] else None) == message,
                     'whole independently derived own first cause')
                field = 'completed' if domain == 'test_run' else 'accepted'
                authority = 'source_first_cause' if domain in ('api', 'parses') else 'qualified_prior_observation'
                need(same(row['status'], dict(field=field, value=observation[field], authority=authority))
                     and type(row['status']['value']) is int
                     and (authority != 'source_first_cause' or row['status']['value'] == int(message is None)),
                     'typed own source-derived acceptance or retained observation')
                need(same(row['native'], pin(canonical(observation)))
                     and same(row['product'], pin(canonical(observation.get('result')))), 'whole own original native and product association')
                if index in empty_set:
                    need(row['raw'] is None and row['semantic'] is None and key not in raw_rows,

                    continue
                used.add(key)
                raw, link, old = raw_rows[key], links[key], inherited[key]
                need(same(row['raw'], raw) and same(old['original'], raw)
                     and raw['body'] == observation['error'] and raw['body_identity'] == pin(observation['error'].encode())
                     and raw['body'].encode() == b''.join(segment['raw'].encode() for segment in raw['segments'])
                     and same(raw['context'], {name: observation[name] for name in ('kind', 'caller', 'helper', 'parse') if name in observation}),
                     'whole own raw body context segments and address lexemes')
                proposed = row['semantic']

                     and same(proposed['context'], raw['context']) and proposed['stack']['body'] == raw['body_identity'],
                     'whole own semantic record cause and raw context')
                forwarding = proposed['forwarding']
                if link['forwarding'] is not None:
                    inner = tuple(link['forwarding']['inner_record'])
                    child = records[inner[0]][inner[1]][inner[2]]
                    relation = link['forwarding']['source_relation']
                    prefix = link['phases'][-1]['classification']['guard_source']['prefix'] + relation['context'] + ' has invalid resolved type: ' + child['error'] + '\n'
                    need(isinstance(forwarding, dict) and same(forwarding, link['forwarding'])
                         and inner[0] == mode and inner[1] == 'api' and same(forwarding['outer_record'], list(key))
                         and forwarding['whole_inner_body'] == child['error'] and raw['body'].startswith(prefix)
                         and forwarding['whole_outer_prefix'] == prefix and relation['inner_body'] == pin(child['error'].encode())
                         and relation['entire_outer_prefix'] == pin(prefix.encode())
                         and forwarding['whole_new_outer_trace'] == raw['body'][len(prefix):]
                         and relation['new_outer_trace'] == pin(raw['body'][len(prefix):].encode()),
                         'whole nested own inner operand outer prefix and new trace')
                else:
                    need(forwarding is None, 'absent nested cause cannot borrow forwarding')
                need(same(proposed, link), 'whole qualified ordered class frame coordinate address and opaque role join')
            counts[domain] = dict(population=len(native_rows), empty=len(empty), nonempty=len(nonempty))
        helper_rows = actual_mode['helpers']
        need(len(helper_rows) == len(source_helpers), 'complete source helper population')
        for source_helper, row, observation in zip(source_helpers, helper_rows, native['helpers'], strict=True):

            domain, first = ('api', min(api)) if api else ('parses', parses[0])

                 and row['primary'] == message and same(row['first_record'], [mode, domain, first])
                 and same(row['failing_api_members'], api) and same(row['failing_parse_members'], parses),
                 'whole own helper source membership and first failed operation')
            need(index == helper_rows.index(row), 'ordered source helper allocation')
        totals.append(dict(mode=mode, domains=counts, helpers=len(helper_rows)))
    need(used == set(raw_rows), 'every complete original raw semantic cause is consumed exactly once')
    return dict(owner=PLAN['owner'], revision=PLAN['revision'], product=pin(canonical(candidate)), inputs=identities,
                allocation=totals, complete_primary=pin(canonical(derived)), complete_contexts=pin(canonical(contexts)),

    result = {}

import copy

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path('docs/audits/record-value-original-contexts-20261005')
JOIN = Path('docs/audits/record-value-original-input-join-20261005')
SEMANTICS = Path('docs/audits/record-value-semantic-join-20261004')
ACTORS = Path('docs/audits/record-value-actors-20261004')


def module(path):
    namespace = {'__name__': 'original_context_prerequisite'}
    exec(compile(path.read_bytes(), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace


join_reader = module(JOIN / 'verify.py')
field_reader = join_reader['field_reader']
graph_reader = join_reader['graph_reader']
result_reader = join_reader['result_reader']
require, load, same, sealed = (join_reader[k] for k in ('require', 'load', 'same', 'sealed'))
identity, digest = result_reader['identity'], result_reader['digest']


def authenticate():
    binding = load(BASE / 'binding.json')
    task = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', binding['revision'] + ':' + binding['task_path']], text=True)
    require(task == binding['task_body'], 'complete committed context task authority')
    require([r['id'] for r in binding['owners']] == [join_reader['PREFIX'] + '3'], 'exact done input/private context prerequisite')
    for row in binding['owners']:
        start = task.index('- ID: `' + row['id'] + '`'); end = task.index('\n- ID:', start + 1)
        require(task[start:end] == row['body'] and '\n  Status: `done`\n' in row['body'], 'whole done context prerequisite body')
    expected = set(load(JOIN / 'binding.json')['archives']) | {str(JOIN), str(SEMANTICS), str(ACTORS)}
    require(set(binding['archives']) == expected, 'complete context/source/operation prerequisite archive domain')
    for path, manifest in binding['archives'].items():
        require(manifest == sealed(Path(path)), 'whole context/source prerequisite seal')
        for name in (*manifest, 'manifest.json'):
            raw = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', binding['revision'] + ':' + str(Path(path) / name)])
            require(raw == (Path(path) / name).read_bytes(), 'whole committed context/source prerequisite member')
    join_reader['main']()
    if (BASE / 'manifest.json').exists():
        sealed(BASE)


def source_models():
    source = load(graph_reader['INPUTS'] / 'binding.json')['sources']['t/1986-isf-record-port-value-gates.t']['body']
    catalog = module(BASE / 'source_catalog.py')
    helpers, consumers = catalog['catalog'](source)
    require(same(load(BASE / 'source-context-catalog.json'), dict(helpers=helpers, consumers=consumers)), 'whole independently rebuilt finite source context catalog')
    products = load(result_reader['PRODUCTS'] / 'products.json')
    # Complete old source/operation allocations are dated prerequisites. Their
    # raw consumer observations are not used as operand or outcome authority.
    old = load(SEMANTICS / 'semantics.json')
    require(len(old['helpers']) == 43 and len(products['actors']) == 4, 'complete qualified original operation domain')
    for index, helper in enumerate(helpers):
        prior = old['helpers'][index]['whole_native']
        helper['api_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['apis'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['consumer_members'] = [r['index'] for r in consumers if r['helper'] == index]
        helper['parse_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['actors'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['copy_members'] = [r['index'] for r in products['private'] if r['whole_native']['helper'] == index]
        helper['api_bounds'] = [prior['api_start'], prior['api_end']]
        helper['parse_bounds'] = [prior['parse_start'], prior['parse_end']]
        require(helper['api_members'] == list(range(*helper['api_bounds'])), 'complete own qualified source helper API span')
        require(helper['parse_members'] == list(range(*helper['parse_bounds'])), 'complete own qualified source helper parser span')
        require(helper['consumer_members'] == list(range(*[prior['consumer_start'], prior['consumer_end']])), 'independent source consumer/helper span')
    return source, helpers, consumers, products


def check(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products):
    actor_models = load(ACTORS / 'actor-models.json')
    parser_sources = [actor_models['sources']['local'], actor_models['sources']['imported'], *actor_models['refused_sources']]
    require("'record-value-controls.isf'" in source and "\"$work/imported.isf\"" in source and "'still-refused.isf'" in source, 'exact source-authored filename roles')
    proof = []
    for mode in ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls'):
        native = records[mode]
        require(len(native['helpers']) == 43 and len(native['consumers']) == 125 and len(native['parses']) == 4
                and len(native['api']) == 9283 and len(native['copies']) == 697, 'complete current context operation population')
        for model, actual in zip(helpers, native['helpers']):
            require(same({k: actual[k] for k in ('label', 'pattern', 'caller')},
                         {k: model[k] for k in ('label', 'pattern', 'caller')}), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
            index = model['index']
            for section, label in (('api', 'api'), ('consumers', 'consumer'), ('parses', 'parse')):
                members = model[label + '_members']
                bounds = [actual[label + '_start'], actual[label + '_end']]
                require(all(type(n) is int for n in bounds) and members == list(range(*bounds)), 'whole own source helper operation span')
                require(members == [i for i, row in enumerate(native[section]) if row['helper'] == index], 'complete own source helper operation membership')
            require(model['copy_members'] == [i for i, row in enumerate(native['copies']) if row['helper'] == index], 'complete own source helper private copy membership')
        for model, actual in zip(consumers, native['consumers']):
            require(same({k: actual[k] for k in ('kind', 'label', 'helper', 'caller')},
                         {k: model[k] for k in ('kind', 'label', 'helper', 'caller')}), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
        receipt = next(r for r in execution['modes'] if r['mode'] == mode)
        parsed = []
        for index, actual in enumerate(native['parses']):
            original = products['actors'][index]['whole_native']
            require(same(actual['caller'], original['caller']) and same(actual['helper'], original['helper']), 'own qualified parser caller/helper context')
            arguments = graph_reader['thaw'](actual['before'])
            require(type(arguments) is list and len(arguments) == 2 and type(arguments[1]) is str
                    and arguments[0] == parser_sources[index], 'whole source-authored parser input text/context')
            filename = arguments[1]
            if index == 1:
                # The random basename and historical absolute prefix are opaque
                # retained capture coordinates, not reusable runtime paths.
                suffix = receipt['fixture'] + r'/\.artifacts/tmp/tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+/imported\.isf'
                require(re.search(r'(?:^|/)' + re.escape(receipt['fixture']) + r'/\.artifacts/tmp/tests/[A-Za-z0-9_]+/imported\.isf$', filename) is not None,
                        'own imported parser filename role/fixture suffix')
                require("print {$file} '" + actor_models['sources']['shared'] + "';" in source, 'whole source-authored imported package fixture')
            else:
                require(filename == ('record-value-controls.isf' if index == 0 else 'still-refused.isf'), 'exact source-authored logical parser filename')
            require(same(actual['before'], actual['after']), 'whole parser input context readonly')
            members = [r['index'] for r in products['apis'] if r['whole_native']['parse'] == index]
            require(members == list(range(actual['api_start'], actual['api_end']))
                    and members == [i for i, row in enumerate(native['api']) if row['parse'] == index], 'complete own parser API operation span')
            parsed.append(dict(index=index, raw_filename=filename, source_input=identity(arguments[0].encode()),
                               whole_before=digest(actual['before']), caller=actual['caller'], helper=actual['helper'], api_members=members))
        proof.append(dict(mode=mode, source_helpers=helpers, source_consumers=consumers, parsers=parsed,
                          raw_helpers=digest(native['helpers']), raw_consumers=digest(native['consumers']), raw_parsers=digest(native['parses'])))
    return proof


def controls(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products):
    rejected = []

    def reject(name, change, cause):
        bad = copy.deepcopy(records); change(bad)
        try:
            check(bad, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products)
        except ValueError as error:
            require(str(error) == cause, 'wrong intended source-context control cause: ' + name)
            rejected.append(dict(control=name, status=1, error=str(error)))
        else:
            raise ValueError('false-green source-context control: ' + name)

    reject('wrong-helper-label', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(label='whole input target'), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-pattern', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(pattern='(?^:wrong cause)'), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-caller', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0]['caller'].__setitem__(2, 116), 'exact source-authored helper label/pattern/caller')
    reject('wrong-helper-span', lambda n: n['ordinary']['helpers'][0].update(consumer_end=12), 'whole own source helper operation span')
    reject('borrow-api-owner', lambda n: n['ordinary']['api'][820].update(helper=1), 'complete own source helper operation membership')
    reject('wrong-consumer-label', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0].update(label='reference validation retains original typed JSON'), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-consumer-kind', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0].update(kind='ok'), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-consumer-caller', lambda n: n['ordinary']['consumers'][0]['caller'].__setitem__(2, 56), 'exact source-authored consumer kind/label/helper/caller')
    reject('wrong-parser-source', lambda n: n['ordinary']['parses'][0]['before'][1].__setitem__(0, '(actor wrong)'), 'whole source-authored parser input text/context')
    reject('borrow-parser-fixture', lambda n: n['ordinary']['parses'][1]['before'][1].__setitem__(1, 'imported.isf'), 'own imported parser filename role/fixture suffix')
    reject('omit-helper', lambda n: n['controls']['helpers'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    reject('omit-consumer', lambda n: n['controls']['consumers'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    reject('omit-parser', lambda n: n['controls']['parses'].pop(), 'complete current context operation population')
    return rejected


def main():
    authenticate()
    source, helpers, consumers, products = source_models()
    records = {m: load(result_reader['CAPTURE'] / (m + '.json')) for m in ('ordinary', 'storable', 'controls')}
    execution = load(result_reader['CAPTURE'] / 'execution.json')
    result = dict(proofs=check(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products),
                  controls=controls(records, execution, source, helpers, consumers, products))
    path = BASE / 'proofs.json'

        require(same(load(path), result), 'complete saved original source-context/span proof')
    else:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check current class/frame/coordinate/address facts and unrelated source currency."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import book_source_references as plane
import record_value_epoch_fact as epoch_fact
import record_value_public_reference_fact as public_reference_fact
import record_value_expression_fact as expression_fact
import record_value_coordinate_fact as coordinate_fact
import record_value_address_fact as address_fact
import record_value_observer_fact as observer_fact
import record_value_observer_namespace_fact as observer_namespace_fact
import record_value_raw_fact as raw_fact
import record_value_cause_fact as cause_fact
import record_value_consumer_fact as consumer_fact
from decision_store_git import MAX_TRACKED_PATHS

ROOT = plane.ROOT
HISTORICAL = Path('docs/audits/record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006')
COMMAND = 'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B scripts/check_record_value_publication.py'
BUILD = COMMAND + ' --build .artifacts/class-frame-current-book'
# Dated admission readers import this public stream when validating saved results.
# Extend the checked semantics without changing their historical stdout contract.
SUCCESS = 'PASS current class/frame facts, complete current source/query allocation and unchanged capacity/source contracts.\n'
EPOCH_REVISION = 'f7bcdaf5e9c2b831b79497dbe7c704dd1fd0c1d9'
EPOCH_CHECKS = Path('docs/audits/coordinate-admission-checks-20261007')
QUESTION = 'why did the class/frame current reader reject unrelated Knowledge Map updates?'
OLD_SCOPE = '''Historical success does not establish current card/query/reader/source currency. Current
publication checks complete core/helper/tooling meanings/question ownership, unique book
guidance, canonical selection/endpoints/bytes/ignore policy, exact current budget and
indexed members. Original destination-locality replay remains required. Explicit factory
output checks remain required for native copied bytes; visual QA stays pending.
'''
NEW_SCOPE = '''Historical success proves no current card/query/reader/source currency. Current checks
complete core/helper/tooling meanings/questions, unique book guidance, canonical
selection/endpoints/bytes/ignore policy, exact budgets and indexed members. Original
destination-locality replay and factory native copied-byte checks remain required;
visual QA stays pending.

The old class/frame current check froze unrelated card bytes/queries. This route
derives complete global source allocation.
'''


def require(condition, cause):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def same(left, right):
    return json.dumps(left, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) == json.dumps(right, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)


def identity(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw), sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())


def historical():
    """Keep the complete sealed programme and its snapshot predicate unchanged."""
    namespace = {'__name__': 'retained_publication', '__file__': str(HISTORICAL / 'verify.py')}
    exec(compile((HISTORICAL / 'verify.py').read_bytes(), str(HISTORICAL / 'verify.py'), 'exec'), namespace)
    require(same(namespace['load'](HISTORICAL / 'manifest.json'), namespace['members']()),
            'complete immutable historical publication seal')
    return namespace


def expected_cards(prior):
    result = {}
    for path, text in prior['model']['cards']().items():
        old = prior['model']['COMMAND']
        require(text.count(old) == 1 and text.count('date: 2026-10-06\n') == 1,
                'unique original current card route and date')
        result[path] = text.replace(old, COMMAND, 1).replace('date: 2026-10-06\n', 'date: 2026-10-07\n', 1)
        if path == prior['TOOLING']:
            require(result[path].count(OLD_SCOPE) == 1, 'complete original tooling current-scope paragraph')
            result[path] = result[path].replace('date: 2026-10-07\n',
                '  - "' + QUESTION + '"\ndate: 2026-10-07\n', 1).replace(OLD_SCOPE, NEW_SCOPE, 1)
            result[path] = epoch_fact.extend(result[path])
            result[path] = public_reference_fact.extend(result[path])
            result[path] = expression_fact.extend(result[path])
    return consumer_fact.cards(cause_fact.cards(raw_fact.cards(observer_fact.cards(address_fact.cards(coordinate_fact.cards(result))))))


def guide(prior):
    book = prior['book']
    result = book['GUIDE'].replace(book['BUILD'], BUILD).replace(book['COMMAND'], COMMAND)
    result = result.replace('Unrelated book\nprogress is permitted by the current reader.',
        'Unrelated book and non-target Knowledge Map progress is permitted. The current\n'
        'reader derives the complete global question allocation and physical census from\n'
        'current canonical sources; the saved historical snapshot keeps its exact epoch.')
    return observer_namespace_fact.guide(observer_fact.guide(address_fact.guide(coordinate_fact.guide(result))))


def sources():
    """Enumerate both canonical scan roots; reject foreign or nonregular inputs.

    The existing finite Git population and canonical-source byte bounds apply
    before reads. No submodule, symlink directory or nested repository is entered.
    """
    result = {}
    for root in ('docs/knowledge', 'docs/decisions'):
        plane.local_parents(ROOT / root / 'endpoint')
        for directory, children, files in os.walk(ROOT / root, followlinks=False):
            base = Path(directory)
            for child in children:
                plane.local_parents(base / child / 'endpoint')
            for name in sorted(files):
                if not name.endswith('.md'):
                    continue
                path = base / name
                require(len(result) < MAX_TRACKED_PATHS, 'bounded canonical source population')
                relative = str(path.relative_to(ROOT))
                raw = plane.local_read(path, plane.SOURCE_BYTES)
                raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
                result[relative] = raw
    return dict(sorted(result.items()))


def authority(prior):
    return prior['source_model']()


def current_input(prior, canonical):
    public = prior['public']
    physical = {p: raw for p, raw in canonical.items() if Path(p).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}
    registry = plane.local_read(ROOT / prior['REGISTRY'], plane.SOURCE_BYTES)
    book_budget = next(json.loads(s)['enforcement_ceilings']['bytes_each']
                       for s in registry.decode().splitlines() if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'shipped_behavior')
    return dict(cards={p: canonical[p].decode() for p in expected_cards(prior)},
        chapter=plane.local_read(ROOT / prior['CHAPTER'], book_budget).decode(),
        tooling_chapter=plane.local_read(ROOT / prior['TOOLING_CHAPTER'], book_budget).decode(),
        queries=public['queries'](), census=public['metrics'](physical),
        surface=public['authority'](registry), source_members={p: identity(raw) for p, raw in canonical.items()},
        source_budget=next(json.loads(s) for s in registry.decode().splitlines()
                           if json.loads(s).get('surface_id') == 'book_source_manifest'))


def check(record, canonical, prior, declared):
    require(type(record) is dict and set(record) == {
        'cards', 'chapter', 'tooling_chapter', 'queries', 'census', 'surface', 'source_members', 'source_budget'},
        'closed complete current publication input')
    expected = expected_cards(prior)
    require(record['cards'] == expected and all(canonical.get(p) == text.encode() for p, text in expected.items()),
            'complete current target meanings questions metadata and replay routes')
    require(record['chapter'].count(guide(prior)) == 1 and record['chapter'].count(prior['book']['EPOCH']) == 1,
            'unique complete current and retained publication guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(raw_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted raw source guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(coordinate_fact.PARSER_GUIDE) == 1
            and record['tooling_chapter'].count(coordinate_fact.REFERENCE) == 1,
            'complete current coordinate parser and tooling guidance')
    require(record['tooling_chapter'].count(address_fact.REFERENCE) == 1,
            'complete current finite address tooling guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(cause_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted cause source guidance')
    require(record['chapter'].count(consumer_fact.GUIDE) == 1,
            'unique complete admitted consumer source guidance')
    pins = record['source_members']
    require(type(pins) is dict and all(type(pin) is dict and set(pin) == {'bytes', 'sha256'}
        and type(pin['bytes']) is int and pin['bytes'] >= 0 and type(pin['sha256']) is str
        for pin in pins.values()), 'current source member identity kinds')
    require(same(pins, {p: identity(raw) for p, raw in canonical.items()}),
            'complete independently enumerated current source members')
    physical = {p: raw for p, raw in canonical.items() if Path(p).parent == Path('docs/knowledge')}
    prior['public']['within'](record['census'], record['surface'])
    require(same(record['census'], prior['public']['metrics'](physical)), 'complete current physical census')
    require(same(record['surface'], declared['surface']), 'unchanged current collection authority')
    require(type(record['queries']) is dict and set(record['queries']) == {'direct', 'cached'},
            'complete actual current query roles')
    allocation = prior['metadata']['allocation'](canonical)
    target = sorted(prior['metadata']['allocation']({p: t.encode() for p, t in expected.items()})['rows'].splitlines())
    for role, actual in record['queries'].items():
        require(type(actual) is dict and set(actual) == {'command', 'status', 'stdout', 'stderr'},
                'closed actual current query result')
        require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0, 'actual current query integer success')
        command = ['knowledge-map/scripts/query_knowledge_map.sh', '--all'] + (['--no-cache'] if role == 'direct' else [])
        require(actual['command'] == command and actual['stderr'] == '' and type(actual['stdout']) is str,
                'distinct actual current query command and streams')
        ids = {Path(path).stem for path in expected}
        queried = [line.split('\t') for line in actual['stdout'].splitlines()]
        require(all(len(row) == 3 for row in queried), 'complete current target question ownership')
        rows = sorted('\t'.join(row) for row in queried if ids.intersection(row[1].split(',')))
        require(rows == target, 'complete current target question ownership')
        require(actual['stdout'] == allocation['rows'], 'complete source-derived current global query allocation')
    require(same(record['source_budget'], declared['source_budget']), 'unchanged current canonical source budget')
    original = prior['load'](Path('docs/audits/book-source-plane-20261005/book-authority.json'))['block'].split('\nThe asset plane is available;', 1)[0]
    require(record['tooling_chapter'].count(original) == 1, 'complete canonical source and native build roles')
    for row in plane.expected_rows():
        chapter = record['chapter'] if row['chapter'] == prior['CHAPTER'].stem else record['tooling_chapter']
        require(chapter.count('](' + row['asset'] + ')') == 1, 'unique complete canonical source destination')


def check_native(html, prior):
    parsed = prior['book']['Visible']()
    parsed.feed(html)
    require(all(parsed.codes.count(command) == 1 for command in (COMMAND, BUILD, prior['book']['DEFAULT'])),
            'native distinct current build and historical commands')
    visible = ' '.join(''.join(parsed.parts).split())
    for block in (guide(prior), prior['book']['EPOCH'], coordinate_fact.PARSER_GUIDE, raw_fact.GUIDE, cause_fact.GUIDE, consumer_fact.GUIDE):
        text = block.replace('```bash\n', '').replace('```\n', '').replace('`', '')
        require(' '.join(text.split()) in visible, 'native complete current retained scope and gaps')


def check_tooling_native(html, prior):
    parsed = prior['book']['Visible']()
    parsed.feed(html)
    visible = ' '.join(''.join(parsed.parts).split())
    for block in (coordinate_fact.REFERENCE, address_fact.REFERENCE):
        text = block.replace('```sh\n', '').replace('```\n', '').replace('`', '')
        require(' '.join(text.split()) in visible, 'native complete current tooling scope and gaps')


def check_public_reference():
    """Consume the dated public reader, including its complete sealed custody."""
    actual = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', public_reference_fact.READER],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT)
    require(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode == 0
        and actual.stdout == public_reference_fact.SUCCESS and actual.stderr == '',
        'complete actual dated public reference qualification')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--build', help='repository-relative current native book output')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(Path.cwd().resolve() == ROOT, 'invoke current publication from repository root')
    prior = historical()
    command = ['python3', '-B', str(HISTORICAL / 'verify.py')]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    require(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0
        and result.stdout == prior['SUCCESS'] and result.stderr == '', 'complete actual historical snapshot replay')
    expected = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', EPOCH_REVISION + ':'
        + str(EPOCH_CHECKS / 'independent-final.json')]))
    require(type(expected['status']) is int and expected['status'] == 0, 'qualified committed historical epoch result')
    epoch = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', str(EPOCH_CHECKS / 'verify_result.py')], capture_output=True, text=True)
    require(type(epoch.returncode) is int and epoch.returncode == 0
        and epoch.stdout == expected['stdout'] and epoch.stderr == '', 'complete actual historical epoch and native result qualification')
    check_public_reference()
    expression = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', expression_fact.READER],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT)
    admitted = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-replace-objects', 'show',
        expression_fact.REVISION + ':docs/audits/coordinate-expression-alternative-checks-20261009/checks.json']))['published']
    require(type(admitted['status']) is int and admitted['status'] == 0
        and type(expression.returncode) is int and expression.returncode == 0
        and expression.stdout == admitted['stdout'] and expression.stderr == '',
        'complete actual sealed expression alternative qualification')
    coordinate_before = coordinate_fact.authenticate()
    address_before = address_fact.authenticate()
    observer_before = observer_fact.authenticate()
    namespace_before = observer_namespace_fact.authenticate()
    raw_before = raw_fact.authenticate()
    cause_before = cause_fact.authenticate()
    consumer_before = consumer_fact.authenticate()
    canonical = sources()
    check(current_input(prior, canonical), canonical, prior, authority(prior))
    rows = plane.expected_rows()
    plane.check(rows, args.build)
    plane.check_index(rows)
    if args.build:
        output = ROOT / plane.relative(args.build)
        html = plane.local_read(output / (prior['CHAPTER'].stem + '.html'), plane.SOURCE_BYTES * 4).decode()
        check_native(html, prior)
        tooling_html = plane.local_read(output / (prior['TOOLING_CHAPTER'].stem + '.html'), plane.SOURCE_BYTES * 4).decode()
        check_tooling_native(tooling_html, prior)
    require(canonical == sources(), 'whole current canonical source epoch conserved during verification')
    require(same(coordinate_before, coordinate_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole original coordinate qualification conserved during current verification')
    require(same(address_before, address_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole admitted address qualification conserved during current verification')
    require(same(observer_before, observer_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole admitted observer qualification conserved during current verification')
    require(same(namespace_before, observer_namespace_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole original publication namespace conserved during current verification')
    require(same(raw_before, raw_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole original raw admission and dated source evidence conserved during current verification')
    require(same(cause_before, cause_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole original cause admission and fixed source evidence conserved during current verification')
    require(same(consumer_before, consumer_fact.authenticate()),
            'whole admitted consumer meanings and fixed source evidence conserved during current verification')
    print(SUCCESS, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Authenticate admitted finite primary/raw causes without recapturing originals."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import book_source_references as plane
import record_value_observer_fact as finite
import record_value_observer_namespace_fact as namespace
import record_value_raw_fact as raw_fact

PREPARATION = Path('docs/audits/primary-raw-cause-canonical-preparation-20261011')
CARD = 'docs/knowledge/record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader.md'
REVISION = '08036b4d4207ea879a007a6654fb1e6fd0a0e8aa'
CHANGES = (
    ('Raw bodies/lossless grammar/source joins qualify.', 'Whole cause/raw/empty/nested source joins/lossless grammar qualify.'),
    ('Finite contexts qualify helper/consumer/parser locations', 'Finite contexts bind helper/consumer/parser locations'),
    ('texts/operation spans separately from cause/operand truth;', 'texts/operation spans apart from cause/operand truth;'),
    ('detached private copy preserves outer caller.', 'detached private copy keeps outer caller.'),
    ('Complete source-chain/separate probe replay required.', 'Full source-chain/separate probe replay needed.'),
)
GUIDE = '''Canonical cause publication admits this reviewed non-growing proposal. The
current reader authenticates its full preparation and fixed source roles;
original assumptions/failures/native/private limits retain. Cause-parent
acceptance remains open:

```bash
scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/primary-raw-cause-canonical-publication-20261011/verify.py
```

'''


def require(condition, cause):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(cause)


def admission():
    # Fixed code authority applies before candidate-supplied fields are read.
    raw = finite.local(PREPARATION / 'candidate.json', CANDIDATE)
    require(finite.identity(raw) == CANDIDATE, 'whole fixed cause candidate before first admission')
    return json.loads(raw)


def published(candidate):
    require(type(candidate) is dict and set(candidate) == {
        'after', 'after_identity', 'authority', 'before', 'before_identity',
        'canonical_members', 'correspondence', 'owner', 'previous', 'proposed',
        'queries', 'review', 'revision', 'schema_version', 'scope', 'target'},
        'closed complete admitted cause candidate')
    original = admission()
    require(type(candidate['schema_version']) is int and candidate['schema_version'] == 1
            and candidate['revision'] == REVISION and candidate['owner'] == original['owner']
            and candidate['target'] == CARD, 'exact admitted cause source role')
    before = candidate['before']
    require(type(before) is str and before == original['before']
            and finite.identity(before.encode()) == candidate['before_identity'],
            'whole admitted cause predecessor meanings and routes')
    after = before
    for old, new in CHANGES:
        require(after.count(old) == 1, 'unique admitted cause meaning allocation')
        after = after.replace(old, new, 1)
    require(candidate['after'] == after and candidate['after_identity'] == finite.identity(after.encode())
            and before.split('---\n', 2)[:2] == after.split('---\n', 2)[:2],
            'whole admitted cause meanings questions metadata and probes')
    require(set(candidate['previous']) == set(original['previous']) == set(candidate['proposed'])
            and all(type(candidate[role][key]) is int for role in ('previous', 'proposed')
                    for key in original['previous'])
            and candidate['previous'] == original['previous']
            and candidate['proposed'] == original['proposed']
            and all(value <= candidate['previous'][key] for key, value in candidate['proposed'].items())
            and len(after.encode()) <= len(before.encode()), 'non-growing admitted cause capacity')
    require(raw_fact.encoded(candidate['scope']) == raw_fact.encoded(original['scope']),
            'whole admitted cause source native private boundary')
    require(all(raw_fact.encoded(candidate[key]) == raw_fact.encoded(original[key]) for key in (
        'authority', 'canonical_members', 'correspondence', 'queries', 'review')),
        'whole admitted cause authority source review and query custody')
    return after


def cards(previous):
    candidate = admission()
    require(CARD in previous and previous[CARD] == candidate['before'],
            'whole predecessor cause meanings and routes')
    return dict(previous, **{CARD: published(candidate)})


def preparation():
    manifest = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'manifest.json', EXTRAS['manifest.json']))
    declared, modes = {}, {}
    for name, entry in manifest.items():
        require(Path(name).name == name and type(entry) is dict
                and set(entry) == {'bytes', 'sha256', 'executable'} and type(entry['executable']) is bool,
                'closed complete cause preparation member')
        declared[name] = {key: entry[key] for key in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
        modes[name] = entry['executable']
    require(not set(declared).intersection(EXTRAS), 'distinct cause seal and external receipt roles')
    declared.update(EXTRAS)
    namespace.check_tree(plane.ROOT / PREPARATION, declared)
    require(all(bool((plane.ROOT / PREPARATION / name).stat().st_mode & 0o111) == modes.get(name, False)
                for name in declared), 'complete cause preparation executable modes')
    return declared


def check_actual(actual, role):
    expected = ACTUALS[role]
    require(type(actual) is dict and set(actual) == {
        'command', 'condition', 'expected_status', 'programmes', 'programmes_after',
        'status', 'stderr', 'stderr_path', 'stdout', 'stdout_path'}, 'closed complete cause actual result')
    require(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status'] == 0
            and type(actual['expected_status']) is int and actual['expected_status'] == 0,
            'actual admitted cause integer success')
    require(actual['command'] == expected['command'], 'exact admitted cause actual source command')
    require(actual['stdout'] == expected['stdout'] and actual['stderr'] == expected['stderr'],
            'whole admitted cause actual terminal')
    require(finite.identity(raw_fact.encoded(actual)) == expected['identity'],
            'whole admitted cause actual programme and source custody')


def authenticate():
    declared = preparation()
    candidate = admission()
    published(candidate)
    roles = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'source-roles.json', declared['source-roles.json']))
    require(roles['publication']['revision'] == REVISION, 'exact fixed cause preparation source revision')
    source = raw_fact.source_census(roles['publication'])
    before = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'source-before.json', declared['source-before.json']))
    after = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'source-after.json', declared['source-after.json']))
    require(before == after and before['source'] == source, 'whole conserved admitted cause source epoch')
    proof = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'proof.json', EXTRAS['proof.json']))
    qualification = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / 'qualification.json', declared['qualification.json']))
    require(proof['source'] == finite.identity(raw_fact.encoded(roles)) and proof['qualification'] == qualification
            and qualification['candidate'] == CANDIDATE and qualification['scope'] == candidate['scope'],
            'whole admitted cause qualification source and proposal association')
    actuals = {}
    for role in ACTUALS:
        actual = json.loads(finite.local(PREPARATION / (role + '-actual.json'), declared[role + '-actual.json']))
        check_actual(actual, role)
        actuals[role] = finite.identity(raw_fact.encoded(actual))
    return dict(preparation=declared, candidate=CANDIDATE, source=source,
                source_roles=finite.identity(raw_fact.encoded(roles)), actuals=actuals,
                scope='Complete admitted finite cause preparation and fixed original source/native evidence authentication. No fresh original semantic recapture, later historical-programme currency, native/private identity or cause-parent closure.')


CANDIDATE = {'bytes': 2890658, 'sha256': '12b424c9bbf92e703517550d978915e96c7713c85f6daf281324d71524ff96bf'}


EXTRAS = {'default-actual.json': {'bytes': 261531,
                         'sha256': '8563d90e0fe3957b8000ffa058e8a91d0b578533139bf129aff442b31931c228'},
 'default-started.json': {'bytes': 130880,
                          'sha256': '04a4701a1f996177145ab63b6d57018b62ae334dfca36445a0dc486270e48759'},
 'manifest.json': {'bytes': 9375, 'sha256': '2e411cbd24816bdf3a69caf9030eb33d57fafd2b41038c228b6cbf948d9fff70'},
 'proof.json': {'bytes': 65797, 'sha256': '47f450cb6484240aebbf8b50c2c386b9759e889575251f77f0e222d998ce77db'},
 'seal-actual.json': {'bytes': 261534,
                      'sha256': 'b75e55e60f97434e08c211d2279993e7e1ca2d7f3baef8a5c2a2830b82699074'},
 'seal-started.json': {'bytes': 130883,
                       'sha256': 'f78eeb2cf376ba00e5feeaa0274e9cf14d04324bb393c4d3702251eb56ddd043'},
 'staged-doctrines-actual.json': {'bytes': 336290,
                                  'sha256': '4a3b263506912e4f9f72480c75a205d78fdc50f6faba2258b343dcddb1f9a931'},
 'staged-doctrines-started.json': {'bytes': 135315,
                                   'sha256': '25808fa7c9e177ef9cedd77c1a42b0ad72184fb6a2e2f026a63991a270194d52'}}


ACTUALS = {'association': {'command': ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh',
                             '--',
                             'python3',
                             '-B',
                             'docs/audits/primary-raw-cause-association-20261011/verify.py'],
                 'identity': {'bytes': 287022,
                              'sha256': '7febce6af6607f2a801df897a2d7e12a41bf3fd7ed546aa31142b5bd2018b8f8'},
                 'stderr': 'ram-guard: PID 74531; host 74.3%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; '
                           'poll 2s\n',
                 'stdout': 'PASS complete finite independent primary/raw cause association; canonical and '
                           'cause-parent acceptance remain open.\n'},
 'independent': {'command': ['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh',
                             '--',
                             'python3',
                             '-B',
                             'docs/audits/primary-raw-cause-canonical-preparation-20261011/reader.py'],
                 'identity': {'bytes': 261545,
                              'sha256': '4223b996828067a042ee62d9ec3e70a86e718047b9f4fcbdfbbb33c5c547b5fa'},
                 'stderr': 'ram-guard: PID 76107; host 76.2%; host cutoff 88%; descendant RSS cutoff 4096 MiB; '
                           'poll 2s\n',
                 'stdout': 'PASS independent complete non-growing source-bound cause canonical preparation; '

"""Authenticate admitted finite primary/raw consumers without recapturing originals."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

"""Authenticate admitted finite raw source facts at their original source epochs."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import book_source_references as plane
import record_value_observer_fact as finite
import record_value_observer_namespace_fact as namespace

PREPARATION = Path('docs/audits/raw-canonical-preparation-20261011')
CARD = 'docs/knowledge/record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader.md'
CANDIDATE = {'bytes': 15449, 'sha256': 'ef7b15d1140a3d39a64834cbd815b1a099b643189e4b8085c5dead67e78303ad'}
EXTRAS = {'default-actual.json': {'bytes': 91885,
                         'sha256': '05d444017c103cd6cd1a5a06e4d4dc65a0d65edd397dfb9685b1632032caa732'},
 'default-started.json': {'bytes': 46033,
                          'sha256': '8876aac711d019c9c609ff5c957b7d006b578e600cec10ccde00751d7c744c58'},
 'manifest.json': {'bytes': 10733,

 'proof.json': {'bytes': 191324,

                      'sha256': 'df7d13bccd2ed63a742e3133cc8b839daae224f937ff6292dc5873e7e79d15ca'},
 'seal-started.json': {'bytes': 46036,
